tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /shrī badz+ra yo gi n+yā kalpa s+ya bi bha ṣa tā ga mash+tsa yuk+tā nāṃ bhi sho ṣa na ma bi ha ra tisma/ /
༄༅/ /shrī badz+ra yo gi n+yā kalpa s+ya bi bha ṣa tā ga mash+tsa yuk+tā nāṃ bhi sho ṣa na ma bi ha ra tisma/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// shrī badz+ra yo gi n+yā kalpa s+ya bi bha ṣa tā ga mash+tsa yuk+tā nāṃ bhi sho ṣa na ma bi ha ra tisma//

༄༅// dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i cho ga'i rnam bshad lung dang rigs pa'i gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru badz+ra wā ra hi ye/ bla med rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas go 'phangs rin thang bral ba'i yid bzhin nor de bde blag nyid du stsol ba de ni rnal 'byor ma dpal yi dam lha// lha yi lha mchog he ru ka dang gnyis med nyid du mnyam par sbyor gang mi yi rnam par rol pa gang zhig bdag cag rnams kyi 'dren par thob// thob pa'i bka' drin bdud rtsis chang gis rtag tu myos pa'i bde chen dang ldan nyams rtog bzang po'i snod dang ldan par skal ldan bdag cag rjes su bzung*// bzung ba tsam min byang chub bar du rigs kyi bdag po nyid du mdzod kyai khyab bdag dpal ldan bla ma kye zhes yang yang dad pas gsol bar bgyi// yid 'ong li khri'i lhun po che dang nyin mor byed pa lhan cig gnas la mtshan dpe'i grogs ldan mthong na mi mthun med pa'i sku// rab snyan dri za'i pi wang las phrogs gdong bzhi'i gsung dbyangs drug cu dang 'dres nyan na bde ster mi shig nā da'i sgra ldan gsungs// shes bya rgya mtsho ji bzhin yongs mkhyen dbyings dang ro gcig e waṃ zung 'jug 'gyur ba med pa rdo rje lta bu'i thugs mnga' ba// 'phags ma khyod kyis nā ro pa dang bsod nams rtse mo rjes su bzung ltar brtse ba chen po'i phyag ring brkyang nas bskyang du gsol// gsang mtha'i rgyud don ji bzhin yongs mkhyen grub pa'i mkha' la thog med 'phyo// nā ro ta pa pham mthing pa sogs tshogs bshad drang ba'i gtam spangs te// snying po'i don la gcig tu gzhol pas skal ldan rnams la ston pa'i chos// slob mar bshad bya'i nges don 'dzin pa'i paṇa grub de dag lan brgyar bsngags// gangs ri'i spo 'dir rgyud don shes rlom dreg ldan ri dwags ches mang yang*// nges don gdong lngas rnam par mdzes shing lung rigs gad rgyang cher bsgrags mkhan// gnyis 'dzin rnam rtog glang po'i klad 'gems smra ba'i seng ge khyod gcig ces// bsngags par 'os de blo gros grags pa 'jig rten mig gcig khyod kho na// shes rab sgyu ma'i gzugs can rnal 'byor mas// dag pa'i mkhar khrid gangs can skye rgyu'i dpal// gong ma rnam lngar grags pa'i sgra snyan gyis// 'jig rten gsum po mdzes kyis gzhan dag min// de dag kun gyi bstan pa rin po che// bshad dang sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser thogs te// sa gsum mchog gi 'dod pas re skong mkhan// e waṃ pa zhes rgyal bas yang yang bsngags// mi yi gzugs kyi gos hril spub dog por// zab rgyas rgyud sde'i bdag po sbas pa'i tshul// mngon gyur kha'u yab sras grags pa'i 'od// stong phrag du mas dga' tshal nyams su dga' ba der// dag pa'i 'khor tshogs chu skyes tshogs pa'i dbus// rtag par rgyun du zab rgyas glu dbyangs len// mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar rgyal yum bh+ra ma raḥ

/de nyid tshegs med snyigs ma'i tshe gcig la// sgrub pa'i thabs tshul zab dang rgya che ba// du ma'i nang nas u dum wa ra bzhin// ches 'phags rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i lugs srol te// gzhi yi bam̐ yig gdod ma'i rnal 'byor ma// lam rgyud bskyed rdzogs nyams len la brten nas// 'bras rgyud kha sbyor bdun ldan sgrub pa 'di// zab pa'i yang rtse nā ro ta pa'i lugs// chos 'dir legs mkhyen rnam 'dren bka' drin dang*// skye ba du mar 'jam mgon sa skya pa'i// snyan brgyud bdag gir spyod pa'i rten 'brel las// lam 'dir rmong ba'i mgo bo 'phur dgos bral// 'on kyang mang pos thos rung 'ga' zhig gis// yi ge'i lam du nye bar phabs pa la// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang rdo rje'i chos srung gis// gnang ba'i skabs phyes mthar phyin sdong grogs mdzod// de la 'dir dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rtsa bshad kyi rgyud thams cad kyi dgongs pa'i mthar thug rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i zab bshad/ dpal rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas grub mchog nā ro ta pa la dngos su gnang ba'i zab pa'i yang rtse nā ro mkha' spyod du grags pa'i lhag pa'i lha yi bskyed rdzogs la gcig tu gzhol ba'i gang zag gi lam gyi yan lag tshogs bsags shing sgrib pa sbyang ba'i thabs mchog tshes bcu'i cho ga'i rnam par bshad pa lung rigs kyis brgyan pa yang dag pa'i gzhung dang mi 'gal ba 'jam mgon sa skya pa yab sras kyis dgongs don dpyis phyin par zhig bri bar bya'o// de yang tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos/ e ma da ni ḍā ki dbyings nas bzhengs// he ru ka dpal rgyud kyi rgyal po las// rdo rje btsun mo'i nye ba'i snying po mchog /bklag pas 'grub ces gsungs pa'i bden pas skyongs// zhes gsungs pa'i don 'og nas 'chad 'gyur bzhin dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs nye ba'i snying po oṃ gsum ma yin pa bzhin du de thams cad kyi sprul gzhi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub tshul yang*/

bde mchog rtsa rgyud le'u zhe bdun par yum la brten nas dngos grub sgrub pa'i tshul dang*/ le'u zhe brgyad par yum gyi nye snying dang*/ le'u brgyad par snying po phan yon dang bcas pa/ lnga bcu par las tshogs bcu gnyis dngos su bstan cing*/ de'i man ngag thams cad rje btsun rnal 'byor mas jo bo nā ro ta pa la dngos su gnang ba'i bskyed rim phag mo mkha' spyod dang*/ rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma'i nyams len gyi rgyun gangs can bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras kyi gser chos mchog sgrub pas thun mong zhar las 'grub pa mkha' spyod skor gsum gang gi skabs su yang nye bar mkho zhing lugs 'di'i rnal 'byor la brtson pa'i gang zag la med du mi rung ba tshes bcu'i cho ga yin zhing*/ 'di la yang gzhung rtsa ba lta bu bla ma sa skya pa chen po'i mdzad pa'i tshes bcu'i mchod pa nyid yin la/ de bzhin du rje btsun rin po che'i tshes bcu dang 'brel ba'i tshogs mchod dang*/ phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i dkyil chog 'phags pa rin po che'i mngon rtogs dkyil chog tshogs mchod bcas pa ni lugs 'di la rgya gzhung lta bu yin zhing*/ de'i rjes su 'brang ba'i yig cha yang*/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i gsung sgros rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ges sgrub thabs rnal 'byor bcu gcig tshes bcu'i mchod pa dang bcas pa mkha' spyod sgo 'byed/ thar rtse paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog a mes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog khyad par tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos rje gong ma'i dgongs don ji lta ba bzhin du bkod pa'i sin+dhu ra'i dkyil chog mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i nye lam/ de'i sogs khong bkros zhing nye bar mkho ba'i gzhung rnams kyang dkyus gcig tu bsgrigs pa bklag chog gsal ba'i me long*/ pra thags pas mdzad pa'i tshes bcu 'bring po'am bsdus pa/

mkhyen brtse dbang pos mdzad pa'i gsang lam cha lag dang bcas pa sogs rang lugs kyi yig cha dpyad bzod pa du ma zhig bzhugs shing*/ yang brgyud pa 'di ka yin kyang gzhan lugs kyi lhad bcug pa'i rnam bshad dang mngon dkyil po ti long ba mang zhig 'dug rung pha bla ma rdo rje 'chang rnams kyi bka' drin las rtog ges dug chus sbags pa'i ltar snang gi mdzes tshon gyi dpe tshogs la kha gdang dgos pa mi 'dug go /gang ltar yang skabs 'dir snyan brgyud 'dzin pa'i skyes chen yongs kyi nyams bzhes gnas gsar rjes mdzad pa'i gsal ba'i me long nyid yin pas de'i don bsdus te bshad cing*/ dka' gnas dang tshigs bcad sogs kyi don spro dgos pa rnams rgya cher spros te bshad par bya ba la/ klad kyi don dang*/ gzhung gi don/ mjug gi don dang gsum mo// dang po la shis par brjod pa/ mtshan bstan pa/ bar chad zhi ba'i phyir phyag 'tshal ba dang bcas pa las gzhan go sla la/ mtshan don skabs mchod phreng rgyas pa dang tshogs mchod sogs kha skong bas zhes pa la blun po dag gi tshar chen rin po che'i gsung der ma tshang ba kha skong ba yin no snyam na de ni ma yin te/ cho ga rgyas pa'i yan lag tu mchod phreng rgyas pa bya ba dang*/ tshogs 'khor ni yig chung gis zin pa nyid kha gsal du btang ba tsam yin no// gnyis pa gzhung gi don la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ sbyor ba la cho gar ma gtogs pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ cho gar gtogs pa'i sbyor ba gnyis las dang po ni/ de la 'dir 'khor lo bde mchog ces pa nas de dag ni cho gar ma gtogs pa'i sbyor ba'o// zhes pa'i bar gyi bstan te/ de'i don cung zad bshad na/ thog mar dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lū nag gang rung gi dbang thob pa sngon du 'gro dgos te/ sbyor ba nges par ma byas pa// skal med gsang ba ston pa dang*// zhes byin rlabs ston pa'i bla ma dang slob ma gnyis kar ltung ba dang bcas shing*/

khyad par dbang ma thob pa'i gang zag la sngags kyi byin rlabs mi 'jug cing*/ sngags la rang dgar zhugs pa'i nyes pa shin tu che ba yin no// 'o na dbang gang yin cig chog gam snyam na mi chog ste rnal 'byor ma 'di nyid rtsa rgyud kyi dgongs pa bshad rgyud rnam pa lngas bkral zhing zab pa'i khyad chos du ma dang ldan pa rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i phyogs yin pas nges par lū nag gang rung gi dbang mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig thob pa sngon du song nas/ dbang dus su thob pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa tshul bzhin du srung zhing*/ rje btsun ma 'di nyid kyi sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba legs par thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa ni gang gi sgrub pa'i rten gyi gang zag go /'o na rje btsun ma'i byin rlabs la dbang bzhi'i don tshang bas smin byed kyi go mi chod dam snyam na/ de ni ye shes skye ba'i sna 'dren tsam las/ lus ngag yid gsum la sku bzhi'i sa bon dngos su 'jog byed kyi dbang ma yin pas ma smin smin par byed pa'i dbang du mi 'gyur te/ rje btsun rin po ches/ byin rlabs phra mo tsam gyis ma yin te// sngags kyi rtsa ba dbang bskur yin pas so// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// des na dpal sa skya pa a mes zhabs kyis/ rab bde mchog lū nag gang rung*/ 'bring bde mchog gang rung*/ tha ma yang dgyes rdor sogs kyis dbang thob pa gsungs pa ni cung zad phyag len zor yang ba'i skyon no// yang 'phros don e waṃ du mkhan rab phyi ma rnams nas lam 'bras gsang dbang gi khrid kyi thog mar rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs mdzad cing de yang zur 'chad pas mdzad pa ni shin tu yang mi rigs te/ 'di'i don bdag rang gi bdag chen rdo rje 'chang drag shul phrin las rin chen la the tshom zhus pa'i lan du yang*/ 'di skabs rdo rje bdag med ma'i sin dkyil gyi byin rlabs dgos pa ni/

lte ba'i gtum mo a thung shad kyi rnam par gnas pa de lam 'bras kyi skabs 'dir bdag med ma dang*/ bde mchog tu mkha' spyod ma dang phag mo sogs su bshad pa ste/ kye rdo rje las/ dang po'i dbyangs yig rang bzhin te// bla ma sangs rgyas rnams kyis bshad// de nyid bcom ldan shes rab ma// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro zhes phebs pa 'di 'thad pa can yin zhing*/ de lta bu'i byin rlabs kyang sngar dbang thob pa'i bla ma zhig las zhu ba ma gtogs/ byin rlabs dang rjes gnang tsam thob pa'i bla ma de rtsa ba'i bla mar mi 'gro zhing*/ ma zad rje btsun sa skya pa'i lugs la lam 'bras kyi cha lag tu gyur pa'i byin rlabs thams cad rtsa ba'i bla ma de rang las thob dgos shing*/ kha gso ba sogs ni gzhan nas kyang zhu chog par bzhed do// tshes bcu rnam pa gnyis sogs dus khyad par can gyi tshe zhes pas nam bya ba'i dus bstan te/ de yang tshogs bsags par 'dod na yar ngo'i tshes bcu dang*/ sdig pa sbyongs par 'dod na mar ngo'i tshes bcu ste 'di gnyis la nang rdo rje lus kyi rtsa thig rlung gsum 'du tshul gyis/ phyi rol du yang gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams 'dus shing byin gyis rlabs pa'i dus khyad par du 'phags pa yin la/ de yang yar ngo la phyi rol du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gong 'phel dang*/ mar ngo la je zad du 'gro ba'i rten 'brel gyis tshogs rdzogs pa dang*/ sdig pa sbyong ba so sor smos kyang gtso che ba'i dbang du btang ba ste/ rtsa rgyud las/ dgun zla 'bring po nas brtsams te// tshes bcu la ni de rab mchod// ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis rlabs pa'i dus chen bzhi dang*/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma gong ma zhi bar gshegs pa'i dus tshes dang*/ gza' skar sogs kyi 'phrod sbyor sogs legs pa'i dus khyad par can la/ kun slong nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag chen mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'i ched du/

rje btsun ma 'di nyid kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa'i sgo nas/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du len par 'dod pas/ gnas ni rang nyid kyi sgrub khang la sogs pa dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su zhes te/ sangs rgyas dang*/ byang sems mkhas grub du mas zhabs kyis bcag shing byin gyis brlab pa'i gnas rdo rje gdan lta bu dang*/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyis sgrub pa'i gnas su byin gyis brlab pa dpal sa skya lta bu/ gzhan yang rang nyid kyi yid dang mthun zhing*/ 'du 'dzi'i g.yeng ba med pa/ chos mthun gyi 'tsho ba dang ldan pa zhig dgos shing*/ skabs 'di'i dben pa zhes pa ni ri khrod sogs la dben pa'i sgra spyir sbyar de 'dra ma yin pa/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i snod du ma gyur pa'i skye bo'i dben pa zhig dgos te/ 'di lta bu'i sgrub mchod kyi nyams len ni ches zab cing gsang ba'i 'os su gyur zhing snod min gyi skad cig tsam yang mthong thos kyi yul du rung ba ma yin no// de skad du yang*/ rje blo gsal bstan skyong gi tshar lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i byin rlabs kyi mtshams sbyor las/ gang du bya ba'i gnas ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ ri bo tshang tshing sman ljongs sam// chu bo chen po'i ngogs dag dang*// gdod nas grub pa'i dur khrod dang*// der ni dkyil 'khor bri bar bya// zhes gsungs pa'i gnas snod dang mi ldan pa'i skye bos dben pa zhig tu bya bar bshad do// zhes gsungs so// gzhan yang a bhi dha na las kyang*/ ri sul dang ni ri rtse dang*// chu bo'i ngogs dang 'dus pa dang*// rgya mtsho chen po'i 'gram dag dang*// shing gcig dang ni zhi ba'i gnas// ma mo'i khyim mam dur khrod dang*// sna tshogs skyed mos tshal mchog gam// lha khang dang ni mchod rten nam// khyim mam bzhi mdo dag tu ni// sgrub pa po yis sbyor bsgrub na// 'dod pa kun gyis 'bras bu gsol// gnas ni brtag par byas pa'am// yid ni gang du dga' ba der// sna tshogs bde mchog dam pa der// de ru bsgrubs na dngos grub 'gyur// dbye ba du mas bsgo ba ni// gdul bya'i bsam pa'i dbang gis so// zhes ri sul te yongs grags lung pa dang*/

ri mthon po'i rtse dang*/ chu 'gram dang chu mang po 'dus pa'i gnas dang*/ phyi'i rgya mtsho sogs kyi 'gram dang*/ gang na shing gcig kho na yod pa'i gnas dang*/ rab tu dben zhing zhi ba'i gnas dang*/ ma mo ste zhing sngags kyi mkha' 'gro ma 'du ba'i khang pa dang*/ gdod nas grub pa'i dur khrod brgyad sogs dang*/ shing dang bya sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i skyed mos tshal dang*/ phyi nang gang rung gi lha rten yod pa'i khang pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi gdung bzhugs pa'i mchod rten gyi drung dang*/ rang gi khyim dang*/ lam bzhi mdo'i bar de dag ni gdul bya dbang po bzang ngan gyi bye brag gis rgyas par phyes nas/ mdor bsdus na/ rang gi snga mo nas yang yang brtag par byas pa'am/ yid dga' ba'i phyogs dang*/ nyer 'tshe'i skyon med cing bde ba dam pa dang ldan pa der sgrub par bya ba bstan pa'i zhar la sgrub mchod gang du bya ba'i gnas kyang bstan zhing*/ der ma zad kye rdo rje sogs rgyud dang bstan bcos gzhan las bshad pa'i gnas kyi mtshan nyid kyang 'dir mi bzhed pa ni ma yin no// des na de lta bu'i gnas khang de nye 'khor dang bcas par chu gtsang mas chag chag gdab pa sngon du 'gro bas byi dor la sogs pa'i sgrib rgyan yang ji ltar 'byor pa bkram par byas shing*/ stabs bde na 'di nyid ma rgyud shes rab kyi rgyud du gtogs pas kha nub bam lho dang de las kyang g.yon pa'i kun spyod dang bstun na lho nyid bde bar bla ma gong ma dag bzhed pas rnal 'byor pa'i zhal lhor blta ba dang mdun spyod kyi tshul du sangs rgyas rdo rje chos sogs rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bris 'bur gyi sku rten dang*/ gzhan yang bla ma yi dam chos srung gi sku rten mtshan nyid dang ldan zhing rab gnas byas pa dag go rim bzhin bsham pa'i drung du/ sngar sa chog byas pa'i gnas yin na smos ma dgos la/ ma song na brtag bslang sbyang gsum rgyas pa'am/

bsdus pa sbyin sreg gi cho gar bshad pa lta bus sa chog byas te/ 'thas shing ngos thams cad gru bzhir snyom pa'i sa stegs sam/ shing dang maṇ+ḍal sogs gang rung la/ tshad ldan gyi ba byung lnga dang*/ gur gum sogs dri bzang po'i chus byugs/ thig chen brgyad spyi dang mthun par btab/ khru gang gi tshad tsam gyis zlum por bskor/ de'i phyi rol tu yang sor phyed tsam che chung dang bstun pa'i zlum bskor gnyis pa bya/ zlum bskor nang ma la dkyil 'khor gyi phyed kyi tshad des shar nub kyi tshangs thig gi g.yas g.yon du rtags byas te chos 'byung gnyis brtsegs kyi thig gdab/ de la rab rin po che'i phye ma/ 'bring 'bru sogs/ tha ma yang phye ma tshos sna lngas kha dog bsgyur bas tshon phye ba'i tshul ni/ chos 'byung gnyis dmar po/ thig gi gcod mtshams kyi re khā ste ri mo dkar po/ nang gi zlum skor dang chos 'byung gi bar khyams ljang gu/ 'di la pa ṭa sogs byas kyang chog cing lag len la yod do// mu khyud sngon po de'i phyi nang gi bcad dkar po/ chos 'byung gnyis brtsegs kyi dbus su pad gdan la tshon spung dmar po bkod pa ni sku tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor ro// de la chos 'byung dmar la re khā dkar bas phyi dkar la nang dmar ba mtshon/ nang gi zlum skor ljang gu pad+ma'i lte ba dang*/ mu khyud sngon pos pad+ma mtshon pa yin la/ rje a mes zhabs kyis chos 'byung gi lte bar pad+ma'i steng du zla gdan dang tshon spung bcas gsungs pa ltar na dkyil 'khor gyi phyi'i pad+ma dang*/ dur khrod mtshon pa yin no// 'di nyid 'jug pa bde ched du dar dmar po la bris kyang chog par gsungs shing sa lugs skabs ras bris la/ dbus su sku dang mthar pad+ma nyi ma dur khrod rdo rwa me ri mda' rwa bcas kyang bri ba'i phyag len yod la/ sku dkyil gyi chos 'byung la dga' 'khyil bkod bshad pa mi 'dug pas ma bkod kyang chog la sku gsung thugs gsum ka'am dbang bzhi ka'i lam mtshon pa'i phyir dga' 'khyil bkod kyang skyon ni med do snyam/

de'i stegs mañji la sogs pa'i khar thod pa dum bu gsum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i nang du chang la sbrang ngam bu ram la sogs pa sbyar/ bsdu sgrub tshad ldan bgyis pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu'i phye ma btab pa dpral ba rang nyid la phyogs par bzhag pa de ni gsung bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba yin/ de'i khar shing phra mo rgya gram du byas pa bzhag ste/ dar dmar gyis kha bkag de'i steng me long ngam/ med na shing leb la sogs pa'i khar/ sin+dhu ra tshags la btsag pa khod snyom par bkram pa'i steng du/ gser thur ram med na rdo rje'i rtses chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi dbus su rgya yig lan war gang rigs sam/ bod yig dbu can gyi bam̐ yig zla tshes thig le nā da dang bcas pa bris pa'i mdun nas g.yon bskor gyis oṃ gsum ma cho ga'i dngos bstan ltar sngags mgo phyir bstan phreng gcig tu yong ba khor yug tu bris/ mdun rgyab spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' 'khyil 'khyil chung bzhi re can bri'o// de ni thugs sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba yin no// 'di ltar byas pas 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa'i dod tshang ste/ rten dkyil 'khor sum rim yod pa ni 'dir dkyil 'khor sum brtsegs byas pa la tshang*/ brten pa lha yang thugs dkyil gyi sngags la tshang ba'i tshul ni 'og nas 'chad par 'gyur zhing*/ gzhan yang sku dkyil gyis bum dbang gi lam/ gsung dkyil gyis gsang dbang gi lam/ thugs dkyil gyi grwa bzhi'i dga' 'khyil gyis sher dbang gi skabs kyi dga' ba bcu drug mtshon cing*/ steng 'og gi chos 'byung gis rnam thar sgo gsum gyi rang bzhin dbang bzhi ba'i lam mtshon no// 'di ltar bsham pa ni rten dang brten pa'i tshul yang grub ste/ rdo rje lus la/ rtsa yi ge de la khams bdud rtsi/ de la snying po ye shes kyi rlung brten pa bzhin/ 'dir yang sku gsung thugs rim can byung ba'o// de rnams kyi steng du dar ras sogs dmar po'i gur phub pa ni rdul gyi gnod pa med pa'i don yin no// bdag 'jug gi skabs 'dir med du mi rung ba ma yin kyang*/

zan gtsang ma'i ting lo dar dkar gyi sdong bu can 'bri mog gis kha bsgyur ba yang dkyil 'khor gyi steng ngam/ mdun gang rigs shig tu bkod/ de'i mtha' skor rnal 'byor pa kha lhor bstan pa'i dbang du byas na dkyil 'khor gyi shar lho 'jig rten pa'i byang shar du mtshams 'dzin me tog bkod pas/ nyer spyod g.yon skor du bsham pa'i mdun rgyab gang bder/ chang dang mar gyis sbrus shing bla ma gong mas sgrub pa'i gtor ma dang dam rdzas bsres pa ku bag can gyi gtor ma lnga'am/ gsum las mi nyung ba rgyan spros sogs gang mdzes dang kha dog kyang dkar dmar gang rigs mdzad pa phyag len du yod pas de ltar dang*/ mchod pa'i nang du ma shong tshe yang nyer spyod bshams dgos shing*/ mchod rdzas du ma ma tshang ba med par 'du byas la/

tshig kha shas chad pa rnams 'ob tshod kha gso byas khul dpyad mdzod/ ) slob dpon nam sgrub pa po'i mdun du rnam rgyal bum pa tshad ldan legs par bkrus shing*/ kha nas gu gul gyis bdug zhal bzhi ba'i sngags bzla bzhin zhabs nas yungs dkar gyis brab par dar ras dmar pos mgul chings prog lnga'am gsum gang rung byas pas mdzes pa'i nang du bla med kyi bum rdzas so lnga dang dri bzang btab pa'i chus gsum gnyis bkang ba'i khar ku sha gtsang ma'i kha rgyan dang*/ dung chos chus gang ba rdo rje la me tog mtshon byed dang skud pa sna lnga'i gzungs thag btags la tshon gyis bris pa'i pad gdan la bzhag 'di la yang rnam bzhag mang du yod kyang rdo rje theg pa'i yo byad kyi rnam bshad rnams su gsal zhing kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ges mdzad pa'i dbang chu'i rnam bshad du rgyas par spros yod pas der gzigs mdzod/ slob dpon gyi mdun g.yas nas rim bzhin nang mchod rdo rje dril bu tshangs zhal rdo rje la bstan pa/ 'dir dngos su ma gsungs kyang*/ ma rgyud kyi skabs 'dir ḍā ma rus rol chen gyi 'go drangs par bshad pas ḍā ma ru tshad ldan me tog gi snod bcas maṇ+ḍal dang*/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i yo byad ma dā na dang*/ bā la gnyis gtso bor gyur pa dang*/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma chung ngu gcig kyang bshams pa'i bar ni cho gar ma gtogs pa'i sbyor ba'o// smras pa/ bla med rdo rje theg pa'i yang snying che// bla med rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i dbang bzhi dang*// bla med chos 'di'i byin rlabs thob nas kyang*// bla med dam tshig ldan de sgrub pa po// rlung sems 'dus pa'i rten 'brel la brten nas// chu shel dbang po gang ba'i dus tshes dang*// de nyid mar 'grib tshes bcu rnam gnyis dang*// gzhan yang khyad par 'phags pa dus su shes// dbang po rab kyis dur khrod mkha' 'gro'i gling*// dbang po 'bring gis tshal sogs nyams dga'i gnas// dang po'i lam pas rang khyim dben pa'i gnas// de ru sgrub pa'i go rim rgyud las gsungs// de lta'i gnas su bskyang nul dul ba'i gzhir// dkyil 'khor bzhi dang drug cu rtsa bzhi'i lha// yongs rdzogs tshom bu bdud rtsi sin+dhu ra'i// rnam par bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor legs par bshams// mchod tshogs kun dang nye bar mkho ba'i chas// rgyud sde'i dgongs pa sgrub pas legs bkral zhing*// nyams ldan dam pa'i phyag len ji bzhin du// bkod pa 'di ni sbyor ba 'tshogs chas so// ces pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// de nas gnyis pa cho gar gtogs pa'i sbyor ba la yang*/

cho ga'i sngon 'gro dang*/ thun gyi sngon 'gro gnyis las/ dang po la yang brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma/ gnas mchod byin rlabs zhar byung dang bcas pa ste/ gsum las/ dang po ni/ rang thun mtshams kyi lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan zhing gnas khang dag pa'i zhing du gsal ba'i mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can nam/ rnam pa gsal ba'i phyir rang rang gi rnam 'gyur dang bcas pa gang rigs khrom tshogs su rang la zhal gzigs shing bzhugs par bsam la/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i rigs bdag ces pa nas/ nam mkha'i mtha' klas 'gro 'di skyong bar shog /ces pa'i bar tshig rjes don dran du 'don pa ste/ 'di'i don brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs go bde zhing bla ma brgyud rim yang nye brgyud kyi tshul yin la/ bla ma dam pa nas bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gi bar du brgyud pa zhig kyang yod mod/ 'dir ni gtso che ba'i brgyud rim gyi dbang du btang 'dug pas de ltar dang*/ zhal skong yang yab rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' blo gros kyi bar khyab che zhing*/ de nas rang rang so so'i brgyud srol rnams ma 'dres pa sbyar bas 'thus la/ de dag gi rnam thar rjes su dran pa'i mdor bsdus tsam re dgos pa 'dug kyang yig cha 'dir yig tshogs lci bas re zhig dang bsring ste/ rnal 'byor ma'i chos skor gyi byung tshul dang*/ de la brten pa'i grub brnyes kyi skyes chen byon pa'i tshul bcas logs su 'chad par spro'o// lam rim smon lam 'di la rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku pad+ma phrin las kyis rnam bshad zhig dang*/ sde dge zhu chen gyi zhal bzang lta ba'i smon 'grel gyi gseb tshags su don 'grel re 'dug pa yig cha de gnyis ka dkon pas 'dir stabs gcig tu bshad pa la/

rgyu dpe grangs gsum gyi sgo nas shin tu rnyed par dka' ba'i dal ba brgyad dang 'byor ba bcu tshang ba'i lus rten gru gzing chen po 'di rang dgar mi bzhag par ji skad du/ spyod 'jug las/ mi yi gru la brten nas ni// sdug bsngal chu bo chen las sgrol// gru 'di phyis nas rnyed dka' bas// rmongs pa dus su gnyid ma log /ces gsungs pa ltar nam 'chi cha med kyi mi rtag pa dran pa'i blo yi ba dan dkar pos bskyod cing bskul ba'i las dge sdig gnyis las/ 'bras bu bde sdug 'jol med du 'byung ba shes pa'i sgo nas de gnyis kyi blang dor tshul bzhin du byed pa mthun pa'i rlung gis rab tu bskul te/ sdug bsngal gsum gyi bar med du mnar ba'i gnas 'jigs su rung ba'i 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po las myur du sgrol bar shog cig ces smon pa ste/ thun mong ba'i sngon 'gro dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ mi rtag pa/ las rgyu 'bras/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs rnams bstan pa'o// bslu ba med pa'i skyabs gnas spyi dang khyad par rdo rje theg pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i dkon mchog gsum la yid ches kyi dad pas gtsug gi nor bu ltar skyabs su 'gro zhing gus pas bsten pa dang*/ tshe rab grangs med pa'i mar gyur pa'i 'gro ba rnams kyi don bdag gis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phangs thob par bya snyam pa'i smon sems dang*/ de'i ched du rdo rje theg pa'i thabs tshul bla na med pa la 'jug snyam pa'i don chen byang chub kyi sems snying la zhugs shing*/ rdor rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi sku las bab pa'i bdud rtsis rang rgyud la yod pa'i skye ba 'di dang thog ma med pa'i dus nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa nyes pa dang ltung ba'i dri ma yongs su bkrus pa dang*/ rje btsun bla ma rdo rje chos dang dbyer med du rgyun par spyi bor bsgom zhing gsol ba btab pa la brten nas de nyid kyi thugs rjes dgyes bzhin du rjes su 'dzin cing skyong bar shog

ces pa 'dis ni skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ rdor sems bsgom bzlas/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor bcas bstan pa'o// rang gi lus tha mal du snang ba dbyings su dag nas mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar ba yid du 'ong ba'i rgyal yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i ngo bor bsgom pa ni/ phyi dbyibs kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yin la/ snying ga'i bam̐ yig rlung sems thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo de nyid ni nang gsang ba sngags kyi rdo rje btsun mo mchog gi rang bzhin dang*/ rang gi sems nyid stong gsal zung 'jug brjod pa dang bral ba ni gsang bas zung 'jug sems kyi mkha' spyod yum yin te/ de dag kyang bskyed rdzogs gang rung gi sngon 'gro ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'i thabs las rang zhal mthong ba'i nyams myong gi rtse dga'i ro la rtag tu rol bar shog cig ces pa ste/ ye shes kyi tshogs dang*/ sbyang gzhi skye 'chi bar do gsum ga sbyong byed lus rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba dang snying ga'i bam̐ yig dang*/ rang sems gsal stong zung 'jug gsum nges pa'i lam rim bstan pa'o// ma dag pa'i snod kyi 'jig rten sa rdo ri brag gi skyon dang bcas par snang ba 'di nyid stong chen yig lnga'i ngo bo e yig rnam thar sgo gsum gyi rang bzhin chos 'byung gnyis brtsegs kyi rnam pa can gyi gzhal med khang dang*/ bcud kyi sems can rigs drug gi rnam pa sdug bsngal gsum gyi bar med du mnar ba rnams kyang thig le stong pa mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po'i yi ge drug gi rang bzhin bam̐ yig rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gzugs su gdod nas grub cing de gnyis ka'ang zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i rol par 'byams su klas pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis/ sgo gsum gyi yul du ci dang cir snang ba thams cad dag pa ye shes kyi rnam rol 'ba' zhig tu snang ba'i bskyed rim gyi rtogs pa khyad par can 'char bar shog cig ces pas gzhi sbyang bsgyur dang*/

'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor gtso bor bstan cing*/ de ltar bshad pa'i bskyed rim de la yang*/ nyal dang ldang dang bdud rtsi myang*// tshad med bla ma bdag lhar bskyed// 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor dang*// dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis brlabs// ngag bzlas yid bzlas gnyis gcig yin// bsam gyis mi khyab rnal 'byor dang*// spyod lam gyi ni rnal 'byor te// de ltar rnal 'byor bcu gcig go /zhes ji skad bshad pa'i grangs phyogs te/ bcu dang zla ba ste gcig gi grangs dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor gyis tshul bzhin nyams su blangs pa'i stobs kyis/ nam zhig gi dus na dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes dngos su ster ba'i ma ma byi ru ltar dmar ba'i mdog can/ li khri'i kha dog can gyi skra sil bur khrol la/ dmar ser gyi smin ma dang ldan pa'i zur mig g.yo ma zhig mngon sum du byon te rig pa 'dzin pa mkha' la spyod pa'i grong khyer gyi gnas der 'khrid par shog ces pas bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig nyams su blangs pa'i grub 'bras rab mkha' spyod la dngos su khrid pa'i tshul can gyi smon lam mo// 'di'i grangs kyi mngon brjod la zhu chen pas bsgyur bkod gnang ba ni rtsis kyi lag len ltar na de ltar yin mod/ gzhung lugs spyi la de tsam du nges pa med de/ 'jam dpal bstod pa gang blo mar yang*/ bcu phrag bcu dang bcu gnyis rgyan spras zhes pas mtshan dpe brgya dang bcu gnyis la go rgyu yin pa las zhu chen ltar na gcig khri nyis stong chig brgya la go dgos pas ha cang thal lo// 'dis mtshon lam 'bras brgyud 'debs su yang*/ phyogs dang gdengs can 'bar ba'i tsaṇ+ḍa li// zhes pa yang go don sor bzhag la/ gtum mo'i dmigs pa bco brgyad yin la/ zhu chen ltar na brgyad brgya dang bcur 'gro'o// gang ltar na rtsis kyi skabs su yang phyogs zhes bcu bkod la de la zla ba bsnan pa'i ri mo yang yod pas zhu chen rang mkhas khyad 'don ches so// yang gang zag dbang po 'bring zhig yin na de tsam gyis grol mi nus pas yi ge'i grangs kyi bsnyen pa lan gnyis tsam song nas grub mchod du ma bgyis pa'i thugs dkyil gyi sin+dhu ra rnams/

laṅga la'i sdong bu'i nang du blugs te/ grogs 'khor lo bde mchog gi gzhi bsnyen mthar phyin pa dang bcas/ ro dang ldan pa'i dur khrod kyi gnas su sgrubs shing grub pa'i rtags byung ba dang*/ sin+dhu ra de des rang gi dpral ba dga' 'khyil g.yon skor gyi spar btab te 'phong ra dang tshogs 'dus sogs kyi yul kun tu nyul bas/ rigs bzang ngan na tshod rgas gzhon lang tsho mdzes mi mdzes gang ltar yang bud med gang zhig gi mdzod spur/ g.yung drung dung g.yas su 'khyil ba'i ri mo can de 'phos pa de'i tshe the tshom dang 'khu 'phrig med par phyag dang g.yon bskor sngon du 'gro bas gsol ba btab pas de nyid mtshan dpes mdzes pa'i rnal 'byor ma gyur nas rang gi lag pa'i 'khrig ma nas bzung ste mkha' spyod kyi gnas su 'khrid par shog cig ces dbang po 'bring gi grol tshul bstan pa dang*/ nang gi phag mo lte ba'i gzhir gnas kyi bam̐ yig rnal 'byor ma'i gzugs su shar ba des phyi gzung ba dang nang 'dzin pa'i 'khri shing bcom pa'i tshul gyis/ ro rkyang gnyis rtsa phran dang bcas pa'i rlung thig sems gsum mchog gi dhu ti ste rtsa dbu mar zhugs pa'i zlos gar mkhan ma de glog 'khyug pa ltar tshangs pa'i sgo ste tshangs bug gi nang thad nas sprin lam gyi dbyings su thon te/ thabs bde ba chen po dga' chen khrag 'thung dpa' bos/ shes rab rdo rje btsun mo'i rang bzhin la 'khyud cing zung 'jug gi rol par gnas par shog cig ces pa ste/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bsam mi khyab kyi bsdu rim bstan pa yin/ rig 'dzin sprul skus 'di dang dpa' bo ba gnyis sbyar ba la ni shes byed med do// lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i pad+mor nam mkha' dang 'byung bzhi'i rlung lnga'i ngo bo ti la ka ste thig lnga la sems rtse gcig tu gtad cing sgom bzhin pa'i rlung sbyor thams cad kyi rgyal po kha sbyor gyi rnal 'byor la brten nas/

lus dang sems kyi rtsa la dri yi bzhon pa rlung zhugs pa yis/ bde ba chen po dang mi rtog pa'i ting 'dzin mchog gis bdag gi rgyud yongs su tshims par shog cig ces pa ste/ 'dis ni rtsa dbu ma che ba'i khrid kyi don bstan pa'o// lte bar gnas pa'i tha mal gyi gtum mo dang*/ spyi gtsug na gnas pa'i 'od kyi gtum mo tsha bsreg 'od kyi mdzes pa dang ldan ma des/ rtsa a ba dhu ti'i 'dzum dkar bzhad pa'i rol rtsed de kha phyes pa la brten nas spyi bo'i haṃ yig gzhon nu yongs su mnyes par byas nas ye shes phyag chen zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i sa thob par shog cig ces pa ste 'dis ni dbu ma kha 'byed pa bstan pa yin no// rang sems 'di dang po 'di nas skyes zhes dngos (ngos )bzung dang bral bas skye ba med pa/ bar du lus kyi phyi nang snod bcud 'khor 'das gang gi steng du yang mi gnas pa/ de ltar skye ba dang gnas pa med pas de la ltos pas 'gag pa yang med pas na/ skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba de yang lung rigs dang grub mtha'i rtog dpyod kyis gsar du bzos pa ma yin pa gdod ma'i gshis lugs yin la/ de lta bu'i sems de la rgyun du bltas shing dran pas ngar dang bcas rgyun bsring pas sems ngo bo dang bcas seng nge ba zhig 'byung ba de ni gsal ba'i cha yin la/ de nyid la zhib tu dpyad pas rnam rtog phra rags thams cad zhi ba'i stong cham me pa ni stong cha yin la/ de gnyis ka yang gcig gis gcig mi 'dor bar zung 'jug brjod du med pa 'dzin pa dang bral ba'i gnyug ma phyag rgya chen po'i ngang de nyid zung 'jug blo 'das rang sems don gyi rnal 'byor ma yin pa phyi rol du mi btsal ba nang nas rnyed pas rang ngo shes nas/ de lta bu'i rgyun rtag tu skyong bar shog cig ces pa ste/ 'dis ni chos nyid dngos bstan gyi khrid gsang chen slob bshad pa kho na la grags pa nyid bstan pa yin no// gzhan lugs pa dag gis/

gsal stong mi 'gal yang gzung na tshogs pas/ slob bshad mkhan po tsho dgos chung mi dgos zer ba 'dug kyang*/ 'dzin pa byung na lta ba min// zhes rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi gsung gi bdud rtsi 'thung ba'i skal bzang la dgos chung gi skyon med pas/ pha rgan btsal bas ma rnyed pa kho ma rgan rnyed pa yin pa'i med 'dzin gyi steng du thugs gzhi gnang la phyi nang gnyis kyi bar mtshams der bzhugs shing*/ mthar rtsa rlung thig le'i 'gros thams cad don gyi e waṃ dhu ti'i mchog gi dbyings su thim/ sems nyid bde chen chos kyi sku'i dpal 'byor thob nas/ de ni ring du mi bzhugs par bgrang yas kyi zhing du gzugs kyi sku'i rnam rol dpag tu med pa bstan pas nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i 'gro ba 'di dag thams cad rnam grol thar ba'i zhing du khrid cing skyong bar shog cig ces pa ste 'bras bu chos gzugs dbyer med kyi sku thob par bstan no// de ltar gsol ba btab pas brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams rang nyid la thim pa'am mi dmigs par bzhag pa gang bder bya'o// //gnyis pa ni sngon 'gro gtor stegs kyi steng du bshams te/ chu dang chang gis bran la/ tshogs pa mang na zhu 'bul dang bcas te/ rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor la/ oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha sogs brjod cing rang gi thugs ka nas khro mo khaṇ+ḍa ro hī dmar skya gri thod 'dzin pa spros te gtor ma gnas pa'i bgegs thams cad bskrad par bsam zhing bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis gtor ma mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du sbyangs te oṃ zhes lag g.yon bstan/ āḥzhes brjod cing lag g.yas bstan te thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che bar gyur par bsam/ gnyis ka bstan te hūm̐ zhes brjod pas sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas gang ba/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya bstan te ha ho hrīḥzhes brjod ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur pa'am/ yang na ho zhes brjod pa bdud rtsi dang*/

ha ho hrīs mang por spel bar bsams kyang chog go /'di'i skabs kyi sngags don ni oṃ ni 'dir dam bca' ba sum+bha gnod mdzes/ ni sum+bha nges par gnod mdzes/ hūm̐ hūm̐ gnyis ni ma rung pa dang*/ gdugs pa can 'joms shing gsod par byed pa/ phaṭa ni khos/ gṛh+na gnyis ni zung zung*/ gṛh+na pa ya gnyis ni zung cig a na ya ho khug cig bha ga wan bcom ldan 'das/ bad+yi rā dza rigs pa'i rgyal po bde mchog gi skabs 'dir badz+ra rā dza yod pa shugs che bas des na rdo rje rgyal po zhes pa'o// oṃ ni gong dang 'dra la/ swa bhā wa shud+dha rang bzhin gyis dag pa/ sarba dharmaḥchos thams cad/ swa bhā shud+dha rang bzhin gyi dag pa/ a ho nga'o zhes pa'i bdag nyid do// zhes pa'i don dang oṃ chos dbyings rnam par snang mdzad kyi ngo bo yin pas stong par sbyangs pa yang de dang mthun/ āḥgasung rdo rje bde ba chen po'i ngo bo yin pas de las thams cad pa bde chen gyi rang bzhin bskyed/ hūm̐ cha lnga ye shes lngas rang bzhin yin pas sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga bskyed pa yang 'thad pa dang bcas pa'o// bya khyung gi phyag rgya ni/ gdan bzhi las/ lag pa gnyis ni bkan byas la// srin lag gnyis ni phan tshun dkris// gung mo dang ni mtheb rtse sbyar// mthe bo gnyis kyis mnan par bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar yin gyis/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgyas go mi chod do// de yang 'dir thog mar ha ho hrī can dang slar yang 'bru gsum lan gsum brjod pa ni snga mas gsal btab cing phyi mas byin gyis brlab pa yin pas de lta bu'i gnad shes dgos so// yang gzhan lugs 'ga' zhig nang mchod byin rlabs 'di'i gong du mdzad zhing*/ mchod pa yang byin gyis brlab par byed mod rang lugs la byin gyis rlabs zin pa'i bdud rtsi'i ril bu nang mchod du yod pa 'di'i skabs su zhar byung du byin rlabs dran par bya zhing*/ bde dgyes kyi rnal 'byor rgyun du byed pa rnams kyis ni nyin re yang nang mchod byin rlabs dang bcas pa yin pas nges par dgos pa'i shes byed med do// de bzhin du sngon 'gro'i mchod pa yang 'bru gsum brjod pas bsdus pa'i tshul gyis byin gyis brlab pa dang*/

yang na yid kyi sprul pa yin pas byin gyis rlabs mi dgos pa bdag bskyed kyi skabs dang tshogs zhing gi mchod pa sogs kyang des rigs 'gre ba'o// phaiṃ gyi bshad pa ni 'og tu 'byung la/ oṃ sngags kyi mgo 'dren/ badz+ra rdo rje/ ā ra li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dgug gzhug bcing mnyes pa/ badz+ra ḍā ki ni rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ dam tshig gzungs shig dri sh+ya ho stsol shig ces pa'o// de ltar brjod pas rang thun mtshams kyi lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis 'dzam bu gling du gdod nas grub pa'i dur khrod brgyad mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par bsam zhing de dag tu bzhugs pa'i phyogs skyong sogs la gtor ma phul bar bsam ste/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ sngags lan gsum sogs brjod/ sngags don ni/ oṃ 'dra/ kha kha zo zo/ khā hi khā hi zo zhig zo zhig sarba thams cad/ yak+ṣa gnod sbyin/ rāk+ṣa srin po/ sa dang gi don/ bhu ta 'byung po/ pre ta yi dwags/ pi shā tsi sha za/ an+mi dā smyo byed/ a pa smā ra brjed byed/ ḍā ka mkha' 'gro/ ḍā ki mkha' 'gro ma/ n+yā da ya de la sogs pa/ i māṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇan+tu/ gtor ma 'di zungs shig sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ dam tshig srungs shig ma ma sar+b+ba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu/ bdag gi dngos grub thams cad bdag la rab tu stsol shig ya the baṃ ji ltar 'di ltar/ ya thaiṣ+ṭaṃ/ ji ltar/ bhuñja tha bzhes shig dzi ghā tha/ snoms shig pi pa tha/ 'thung shig mā ti kra ma tha/ rim pa las gang 'das par/ ma ma sar+b+ba kat+yaṃ/ bdag gi las thams cad/ sat+pu kha bi shud+dha/ bde ba dam pa rnam par dag pa/ sa hā yi ka lhan cig tu/ bha wan+tu mdzod cig hūm̐ gnyis dang*/ phaṭa gnyis/ swā hā ni gzhi tshug cig ces pa'i don no// mthar mchod pas mchod/ nang mchod kyang phul te 'bru gsum dang*/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro sogs brjod/ de nas rdo rje thugs ka dang dril bu nu ma'i thad nas tshig brdung bya zhing*/

phrin las bcol ba'i lha yi tshogs rnams sogs brjod/ de yang steng gi tshangs pa sogs lha/ 'og gi sa bdag lto 'phye sogs klu/ byang phyogs kyi gnod sbyin sogs sems can la mdangs 'phrog pa sogs kyis gnod pa sbyin pa/ lho nub kyi srin po sogs mtshan mor rgyu ba/ byang shar gyi dbang ldan sogs 'byung po dbang che ba/ mkha' la rgyu ba'i yi dwags kha la me 'bar ma sogs srin po'i bye brag mi yi sha khrag kho na za ba dang 'thung ba'i tshogs dang*/ gdon gang lus la zhugs ma thag tu smyo bar byed pa dang*/ de bzhin du lus ngag gi bya ba brjed du bcug pa'i brjed byed dang*/ nam mkha' la thog par med par 'gro ba'i mkha' 'gro pho mo dang*/ yid ma dga' na nad sogs gtong bar byed pa'i bdag mo ma mo tsan+ḍu pa de la sogs pa'i 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad/ ma lus par 'dir gshegs shig bdag la dgongs su gsol/ khyed rnams ni sngar ston pa 'dul byed he ru kas dkyil 'khor du bcug cing dbang bskur te/ bstan pa srung ba dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i thugs kyis dam bcas ji ltar mdzad cing zhal gyis bzhes pa yin pas de'i rgyu mtshan gyis khyod rnams dpal chen po'i bka' ltar du sdod pa dang*/ yid ltar mgyogs pa'i rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pas/ 'jigs pa'i gzugs brnyan can du mdzad cing*/ drag shul dang gtum pa'i phrin las mi bzad pas/ gdugs pa can 'dul bar mdzad cing*/ de dag gi rjes su zhugs pa nag po'i phyogs kyi tshogs rnams 'joms la/ spyir zhi lhag zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin dang khyad par rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i las su bya ba la dngos grub kyi 'bras bu ster bar mdzad cing*/ yon tan gyi mthu dang phrin las kyi stobs sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i gnod sbyin gyi tshogs sogs brgyad po de dag la phyag 'tshal zhing bstod par bgyi'o// sde tshan brgyad po de dag gi btsun mo dang*/

sras dang g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa'i/ dngos su grub pa'i bka' drin sogs kyi nad med pa dang*/ tshe lo brgya thub pa la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa/ skye rgu kun gyi dbang phyug te bdag por gyur pa dang*/ lha dang mi yi dpal dam pa thob pa dang*/ phyogs kun tu snyan par grags pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos kyi bgo skal bzang po dang*/ log 'tsho med pa'i longs spyod rgya chen po kun thob cing*/ nad gdon sogs nye bar zhi ba dang tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas pa la sogs pa'i bsdus pas dbang dang*/ mngon spyod kyi las rab 'byams kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol bar mdzod cig dam tshig can khyed rnams kyi bdag la srung*/ dngos grub thams cad kyi bdag gis sdong grogs mdzod cig dus min du 'chi ba brgyad kyis 'chi ba dang*/ nad rnam pa sna tshogs dang sum brgya drug cur gtogs pa'i gdon dang stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs rnams kyang med par mdzod/ rmi lam ngan pa dang rtags dang mtshan ma ngan pa dang bya ba dang byed pa sna tshogs pa ngan pa med par mdzod cig de tsam du ma zad 'jig rten gyi khams 'di nad mug 'khrug rtsod sogs med pas bde zhing lo phyugs rtag tu legs pa dang*/ 'bru yi tshogs rnams 'phel zhing chos kyang 'phel bas bde ba dang legs pa thams cad 'byung ba yis sgo nas yid la 'dod pa thams cad 'grub par shog cig ces dang*/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi sogs kyis kyang phrin las bcol/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs su sogs kyis bgegs la bka' bsgos shing sum+bha brjod cing rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu drag tu dkrol zhing gsang spyod blta bar mi dbang zhing dbang ma thob pa'i bgegs dang 'byung po thams cad phyir bskrad par bsam ste gtor ma phyi rol du gtsang sar dor ro// 'dir tshigs bcad la dril bu chig brdung dang*/ tshig lhug la gsum brdung sngags la rgyun dkrol las shugs drag tu dkrol ba'o// de yang chig brdung ni dril bu skad cig hūm̐ zhes pa'i sgra can dang*/

gsum brdung gis oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyun chags ni hūm̐ ring po'i rnam pa dang*/ bcad gtubs su dkrol ba yang phal cher gsum brdung gi khongs su bsdu ba yin gyis/ dpon slob legs grub pas tshigs bcad rkang pa gcig bzhag gcig la dkrol ba chig brdung*/ tshigs bcad rkang pa gsum bzhag bzhi la dkrol ba gsum brdung*/ rkang pa sa la ma snyom pa la bcad gtub kyi tha snyad sbyar 'dug pa ni ngag rgyud ngan pas bslad pa yin gyis shes byed med pa'i khar sngon 'gro dang phyi rol gtor ma/ sa chog sogs kyi 'dod gsol la gsum brdung byed pa gsungs pas kyang gnod de/ 'di la shes byed kyi lung yang*/ ngor chen gyis rgyud drangs par/ sgra ni sku gsung thugs su sgrogs// zhes gsungs pa tshig lhug sogs kyang yod do// 'di dag gi gnad ma shes shing mthong brgyud kyi phyag len med na bstan pa'i zhabs 'dren pa yang 'byung nyen yod pas lag len pa rnams bla rgan dbu dkar gyi 'chol gtam la yid brtan ma bzung bar gzhung dang mthun pa'i lag len lung khung btsun la 'bad 'tshal/ gtor mgron ni sgrub mchod ma grol ba'i bar du dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol phyogs mtshams thams cad du bzhugs par bsam pa las gshegs gsol mi mdzad/ gsum pa ni/ de nas gnas dang mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byas tshig gzhan rnams go sla/ mchod pa'i phyag rgya ni mdzes rgyan du yod pas 'dir ma smos la/ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ nam mkha'i khams gang ba'i don yin zhing de ltar bsam la thal mo khong stong gi tshig bar ma gsum bcag pa dpral bar bzhag pa nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bca'/ dngas shing thogs pa med pa ni ma ga dha bzang mo sogs kyi rtogs brjod las 'byung ba ltar mchod yul gang du yod pa der 'gro bar nus pa'i don yin/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi sogs brjod cing rol mo sna tshogs kyi sgra dkrol zhing yid kyis sngags dang pos mchod yul rnams mdun du spyan drangs/

gnyis pas gnas khang bsgom pa ltar byin gyis brlabs/ gsum pas mchod pa byin gyis brlab par bsam mo// 'dir yang legs grub kyis grong gzhis kyi yig tshogs ltar mtha' gcig tu sna tshogs rol mo zhes sil snyan 'khor brdung re la rnga gnyis brdung ba sogs bshad 'dug kyang*/ dril bu rnga rol du sogs rol mo sna tshogs pa dkrol ba'i don yin gyis rnga rol gnyis kho na la btags pa ma yin zhing*/ pad skor re la rnga gnyis brdung ba sogs la mchod rol zhes rol mo'i rnam bzhag tu bshad kyis sna tshogs rol mo'i ming btags pa med do// skabs 'dir ḍā ma ru'i mgo drangs pa'i rol chen yang mdzad pa yin no// sngags don ni/ oṃ sngags kyi 'go 'dren pa/ badz+ra rdo rje/ ghan+ḍe ra ṇi ta dril bu'i sgra sgrogs pa/ pra ra ṇi ta rab tu sgrogs pa/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ yang dag par sgrogs pa/ sar+b+ba bud+dha k+ṣe dra pra tsa li te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad g.yo bar byed pa/ pra dz+nyā pā rā mi ta shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ na da sam bhe we ta sgra yang dag par 'byung ba'i gnas/ badz+ra dharma hṛ da ya/ rdo rje chos kyi snying po can/ san+to ṣa ni/ hūm̐ gsum sku gsung thugs/ ho gsum de gsum dgyes pa/ a khaṃ nam mkha'i khams khyab pa/ swā hā gzhi tshugs zhes so// skabs 'dir maṇ+ḍal zhu 'bul yang tshogs pa mang zhing byed par spro na bde dgyes sogs dang mthun par byas shing*/ ma byas kyang chad pa'i skyon med do// smras pa/ byin rlabs gangs kyi ri bo dad gsum gyis// snang byed zer gyis bzhus pa'i rgyun bzang po// chad med brgyud pa nyal 'gro'i klung chen lags// dngos grub rin chen bum pa legs gtams mdzod// lam gyi rim pa ji bzhin ston pa'i glu// smon lam tshig gi tam bhu rar sbyar ba// yang yang bskul bas skal ldan ri dwags kyis// yid kyi gtan pa mi 'phrog gnas de ci// rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin gdod ma nas// grub pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bdud rtsi'i bcud// gsol zhing bstod dang phrin las bcol ba ni// rgyud sde 'di yi thun mong min pa'i lung*/

nag por mngon phyogs mun par rab dga' zhing*// gsang spyod nyi ma'i 'od la mi dga' ba'i// log 'dren u mu ka tshogs bskrad pa'i tshul// 'di ni gsang chen smra ba spyi yi srol// gnas khang rin chen gzhal yas khang gi dbus/ kun bzang rnam par thar pa'i bang mdzod las// legs byung mchod pa'i yo byad bsam las 'das// sngags dang phyag rgya ting 'dzin stobs las spungs// 'di ltar nyams su blang ba'i rnal 'byor par// bar chad med cing mthun pa'i dngos grub kyang*// rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dgos 'byung nor bu bzhin// 'bad rtsol mi dgos thob pa'i rten 'brel 'grigs// zhes pa'ang bar skabs kyi bsdus pa'o// gnyis pa thun dang 'brel ba'i sngon la rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi skabs su nyal dang ldang dang bdud rtsi myang ba sogs kyang dgos mod de dag khrid yig gzhan du gsal zhing*/ 'dir lam log pa las khyad par du byed pa skyabs 'gro/ dman pa las khyad par du bya ba sems bskyed/ 'gal rkyen sdig pa sbyang ba rdor sems bsgoms bzlas/ byin rlabs 'jug par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ dag gsal gnyis su med pa'i snang ba dang ma 'bral ba'i ngang nas rang gi gnas mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri pad zla'i gdan la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can du bzhugs pa'i sku dge 'dun/ gsung dam chos/ thugs sangs rgyas su bsam pa'i kun 'dus nor bu lugs su sgom pa'i mdun du rang dang rigs drug gi sems can thams cad khrom tshogs ltar 'khod pa de dag gis mgrin gcig tu brjod par bsam la/ skyabs 'gro'i tshig gzhung ltar brjod cing don dran mthar bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas sku'i 'od zer gyis rigs drug gi sems can thams cad kyi sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur pa de yang mkha' spyod ma'i skur gyur te zhing khams su bya 'phur ba ltar song bar bsam pa'am mi dmigs pa bsam pa gang bde dang*/

mthar bla ma rdo rje chos de 'od zer gyi rnam par zhu ste 'od dmar po bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin gcig tu 'dril ba rang gi spyi gtsug nas thim pas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang bla ma'i sku gsung thugs chu la chu bzhag pa bzhin du 'dres par bsam mo// gnyis pa ni/ bdag gi rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sogs lan gsum brjod cing don dran pa ste/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad yid yul du byas zhing rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phangs bsgrub nas de dag thams cad sdug bsngal las bsgral bar bya snyam pa ni smon pa sems bskyed/ de'i phyir du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rim gnyis kyi lam la zhugs pa ni 'jug pa sems bskyed yin la/ skabs 'dir rnal 'byor bcu gcig las tshad med kyi rnal 'byor tshang dgos pas/ sems can thams cad yid yul du byas/ de thams cad sdug bsngal las bsgral 'dod kyi snying rje/ de yang bde ba dang ldan 'dod kyi byams pa las 'byung bas byams pa/ thams cad byang chub tu 'god snyam pa dga' ba tshad med yin la/ yang zin bris 'ga' zhig tu sems can la bu gcig ltar brtse ba ni byams pa/ 'di rnams sdug bsngal las bsgral snyam pa snying rje/ de la brten nas bdag rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phangs thob pa la dga' snyam pa dga' ba tshad med/ rnal 'byor pas thugs rje nye ring med par bskyang ba btang snyoms yin zhes snga ma nyid 'brel chag go /de dag sems bskyed kyi tshig 'di nyid la tshang ste/ bdag gis zhes pas rnal 'byor pa rang nyid rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phangs thob par byas la/ zhes pa de'i dngos bstan rang nyid yin kyang shugs la sems can thams cad bde ba'i mchog sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa byams pa/ sems can thams cad zhes pa'i nye ring gi bsam pa med pa'i btang snyoms/ srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral bar 'dod pa snying rje/

de'i phyir bdag gis rnal 'byor ma'i lam nyams su blang bas bde ba dang ldan sdug bsngal dang bral ba re dga' snyam pa dga' ba tshad med yin par shes dgos so// sems bskyed kyi khrid 'di khrid yig snga ma rnams su zhib cha cher mi 'dug pas cung gsal du btang ba'o// gsum pa ni/ bde mchog sdom 'byung gi gzhung nas bstan pa ngag 'don du byas pa 'di nyid 'don zhing don dngos bstan ltar dang*/ khyad par thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i dmigs rim rnams khrid yig rnams su gsal zhing*/ yi ge brgya ba'i sngags don yang*/ kye rdo rje'i rnam bshad rnams su gsal bas ma smos la/ 'dir stobs bzhi'i rnam bzhag tsam bshad par bya ste/ rang gi spyi bor rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum bskyed pa ni rten gyi stobs te dper na mi zhig sa thog tu 'gyel ba de la brten nas lang dgos pa bzhin/ rdo rje theg pa'i rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad yul thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje theg pa'i rigs kun gyi bdag po rdo rje sems dpa' la brten nas sbyang dgos pa yin la/ de'i mdun du rang gi tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i bcas pa dang ma 'brel yang rang gi ngo bo kha na ma tho bar gnas pa'i rang bzhin gyi ltung ba/ bcas pa dang 'brel ba bcas pa'i ltung ba khyad par rdo rje theg pa'i dbang thob nas de'i dam tshig rtsa ltung bcu bzhi/ yan lag gi ltung ba brgyad/ ma rgyud nas bstan pa'i dam tshig brgyad sogs las 'gal ba thams cad khong du dug song ba ltar 'gyod sems bskyed pa rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs dang*/ phyin chad srog la thug kyang 'di lta bu'i las mi bsags snyam pa'i sdom sems drag por bgyid pa ni phyin chad sdom pa'i stobs yin la/ de ltar byas pa'i sdig sgrib dag nges snyam zhing dga' ba sgom pa nyes pa las ldog pa'i stobs yin no// yang na sdom pa'i stobs sun 'byin pa'i zhar dang*/

lha bsgom zhing sngags bzla ba sogs gnyen po la 'bad pa ni gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs su bzhag pa yin no// de yang rdor sems bsgom pa rten gyi stobs/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa sogs sun 'byin gyi stobs/ sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes pa'i phyin chad sdom pa bstan/ rdor sems rang la thim pas nyes pa las ldog par bstan/ 'on kyang rdor sems sgom bzlas 'di gtso bo rten gyi stobs dang*/ gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs shugs che bar yod do// de ltar stobs bzhi tshang ba'i bshags pa byas na sdig sgrib ji ltar che yang dag par gsungs zhing ma zad sdom pa gsum ka'i bshad pa la stobs bzhi'i tha snyad med pa tsam ma gtogs/ stobs bzhi tshang ba yin zhing 'dul ba'i phyir bcos kyi skabs su ni stobs bzhi dngos su tshang ba zhig 'dug go snyam rang gi rnam rtog la shar ba mkhas pa yongs kyis thugs dpyad mdzad 'tshal/ 'jam mgon a mes kyis bar 'dir sku'i dga' ba dang*/ gsung gi dga' ba dran pa yang gsung 'dug kyang bde mchog gi gzhung dang mthun pas byas kyang lhag pa'i skyon ni med do// bzhi pa ni/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri pad zla'i steng du/ bka' drin gsum ldan gyi bla ma de nyid rje btsun rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can de nyid rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang chos srung thams cad 'dus pa'i rang bzhin yin snyam pa'i blo rtse gcig tu gnas pas/ gsol 'debs ci nus su bya ba tsam las thun mong ba'i skabs 'dir zhal shes rnams mi sbyar la thun mong ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor la 'jug par 'dod na khrid yig snga phyi'i dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin nyams su blang kyang 'gal ba med pa'i khar phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag tu 'gro'o// bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di'i tshogs bsags pa las bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa yang zhar la 'gro bar bzhed la/

de nas bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas bla ma rang sems dbyer med du gyur pa'i ngang las snying ga'i bam̐ yig gzhir gnas kyi rnal 'byor ma'i ngo bo bskyang ba tshar lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i phyag bzhes dang*/ yang na rang gi lus snying ga'i bam̐ yig la bsdus zhing bam̐ yig nam mkha' la 'ja' ltar yal ba'i ngang nas chos thams cad stong pa nyid du sbyangs pa gang bder bya ba ni ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// smras pa/ 'gyur med yon tan lhun grub sangs rgyas dang*// zhi ba dam chos 'phags chen 'dus pa'i tshogs// kun kyang rnam 'dren bla ma la bsdus te// skyabs 'gro'i tshul 'di rdo rje 'dzin pa'i srol// ma gyur 'gro rnams bde ba'i yon tan rdzogs// sdug bsngal rgyu bcas 'bral ba'i thabs la 'bad// de don 'grub pa'i dga' spro dang bcas pas// nye ring chags sdang mgo snyom 'di yang rmad// mi gtsang lus ngan lcags khams gzugs 'dzin mod// thabs mkhas dam pa'i zhal gyi 'dzin ma'i bcud// rin chen byang sems su war+ṇa 'di yis// skad cig nyid la bsgyur zhes yongs su grags// nyes byas bud shing skam po'i khang brtsegs kyang*// skad cig tsam gyis bsreg par byed pa'i thabs// rdo rje sems dpa'i nyams len byin za ni// gang la mchis de gtsang rigs bram ze lags// rin chen rnam gsum gcig bsdus gser sbyangs thod// bcings nas gsol btab cho ga'i khri la 'gyings// rdo rje gsum gyi byin rlabs phyag rgya 'chang*// gang de gsang chen 'dzin pa'i mi dbang des// dag pa'i mkha' la dri mas dben pa bzhin// spros pa kun dang rnam par bral ba'i tshul// rigs srol mang po'i lam la ma brten par// bla ma'i byin rlabs mthu las rtogs 'di 'phags// ces pa'ang bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o// rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ bdag bskyed/ mdun bskyed/ bum pa sgrub pa/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba zhar byung dang bcas pa ste bzhi las/

dang po la bdag lhar bskyed pa'i rnal 'byor/ 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor/ dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis rlobs pa'i rnal 'byor/ bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ rang tha mal du gnas pa'i snying khar e gnyis brtsegs te de yang e thog ma mdun dang steng ma zhal phar log (

e log pa zhig dgos )'di lta bu'i rnam pa can du bsgom pa de las chos 'byung*/ dag gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can rtse mo mdun dang zur gnyis ldeb la bstan pa dmar gtor gru gsum pa 'dra ba'i rtsa ba phra ba gsang gnas kyi thad du zug pa/ gdeng ka che ba gyen du bstan/ de'i nang du de lta bu'i chos 'byung rtse mo rgyab tu bstan pa de'i nang du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bam̐ yig dmar po'i mthar gong sin+dhu rar bri ba'i skabs kyi bkod tshul dang mthun pa'i oṃ gsum ma gyen lang g.yon skor du 'khod pa/ de las 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan 'ja' tshon lta bu 'phros/ rang gi rnam smin gyi lus sha khrag rus gsum phung khams skye mched thams cad sdig sgrib dang bcas pa sbyangs nas lus 'od kyi gong bu gyur par bsam/ de'i ngang las rang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur tshig ris ltar bskyed pa ni bdag gi gzhi sbyang bsgyur zhes bde mchog 'dzin pa rnams kyi grub mtha'i gtso bo yin zhing*/ de lta bu'i gzhi de yang skye ba snga phyi bar gsum thams cad kyi gzhi sbyang ba yin par bzhed pa ni/ 'jam mgon sa skya pa'i bzhed pa yin no// bsgom don tshig ris su gsal zhing*/ yi ge rnying bar rigs bdag chad 'dug kyang phyis mkhas pa dag gis rnam snang gi cod pan can zhes sbyar ba ni shin tu legs te chos rje bdag nyid chen mos/ bskyed pa'i rim pa mthar thug pa// dbu rgyan la ni rigs bdag 'byung*// rigs bdag de ni bla ma yin// 'di ni gal te 'chol gyur na// dngos grub med par rgyud las gsungs// zhes gsungs pas so// cho ga 'dir skabs 'di nyid du go cha 'god pa yang gsungs 'dug pa ni rgyud sde gzhan dang sgo bstun pa ste/ nā ro ba'i dgongs pa ltar na/ byin gyis rlobs pa'i rnal 'byor gyis ye shes pa dam tshig par bstim pa shing gnyis gzer gyis bsdam pa ltar bzhed pa gang ltar 'gal ba cher med de/

'jam mgon kun bsod kyis/ sngon la bsgom pa rgyud gzhung phal cher gyi dgongs pa yin zhing*/ gting la bsgom pa jo bo nā ro ta pa'i man ngag yin gsungs/ zhes gsungs pa ltar kun mkhyen rin po che'i bde mchog gi sgrub thabs su yang gsungs so// de lta bu'i go cha yang gzhung gi dngos bstan ltar gyi sngags dang lha tha dad med par bsam pa yin te/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las/ gal te dngos grub mchog 'dod na// sa dang lam la tha dad med// ces pa'i don yin par dmar chos kyi rgyal po dang kun mkhyen go ram chen pos bzhed do// rtsa rgyud le'u brgyad par/ yi ge bam̐ dang yam̐ dang ni// yi ge mam̐ dang hriṃ nyid dang*// hūm̐ dang phaṭa ces bshad pa ni// rnal 'byor ma ni drug tu bshad// ces dang*/ yang de nyid las/ oṃ hām̐ hriṃ hriṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa drug po rim bzhin du sbyar ba yin no// 'di dag gi skabs snga phyir sbyang gzhi sbyong byed dang mtshon don rgyas par ma smos pa ni khrid yig rnams su yang yang gsungs shing 'dir yi ge'i tshogs lci bas ma spros so// gnyis pa ni/ rang gi snying gar sngar ltar gyi sngags phreng bam̐ yig dang bcas pa skad cig gis gsal btab ste de las 'od zer 'phros pa rigs drug gi gnas thams cad la phog pas de thams cad kyang lcags la gser 'gyur gyi rtsis theb pa ltar snod thams cad chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi rnam pa dang*/ bcud thams cad rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur par bsam pa'o// gsum pa ni/ ji skad du rgyud las/ mdzub mo mdud byas gung mo nges par sbyar// mthe bong rdo rje brtan por rab tu sbyar// 'di ni dpral ba'i dbyings su rab bzhag nas// bskor zhing bskor bas kun nas bskor bar bya// rkang ba mnan cing steng du blta// gyen du phaiṃ gyi sgra sgrogs shing*// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams bzhugs pa'i// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams dgug

/zhes gsungs pa'i don gyi 'bar ba'i phyag rgya lan gsum du g.yon skor byed 'di yang bdag bskyed kyi skabs rang dang mdun bskyed skabs yul la g.yon bskor bya dgos zhes bdag gi 'dren mchog rdo rje 'chang legs pa rin po ches gsungs/ phe e ma gsum gyis gdangs thon par brjod de/ de'i don ni khos shig ces te/ gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gro rnams ma byon na sngon gyi zhal bzhes nyams pa'i nyes pas mgo bo khos shig ces dmod bor ba ste/ sa ma dzaḥzhes dam tshig gis 'dus zer ba dang don gcig pa yin gsungs/ snying ga'i bam̐ yig gi 'od kyis 'og min gyi zhing na bzhugs pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la/ phyogs bcu'i zhing khams thams cad du bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis bskor ba/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od kyis 'gro ba rnal 'byor mar gyur pa thams cad kyang byon par bsam ste 'og min na bzhugs pa'i rnal 'byor ma ni lhan skyes/ yul nyer bzhi na bzhugs pa'i rnal 'byor ma rnams ni zhing skyes/ 'gro ba rnal 'byor mar gyur pa rnams ni sngags skyes te pho nya gsum bsre zhes pa'i don 'byung ba'i phyir/ rdo rje khu tshur gyi g.yas pa'i mdzub mo g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung gi steng nas 'khyud pa lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang*/ dzaḥzhes pas rang gi spyi bor byon par bsam/ g.yas steng du byas pa'i rdo rje khu tshur rgyab sprad zhags mig ltar byas pa zhags pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ hūm̐ zhes pas thams cad 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par bsam/ rdo rje khu tshur kha gyen du bstan pa'i mdzub mo dang mthe'u chung phan tshun 'khyud pa lcags sgrog gi phyag rgya dang*/ baṃ zhes pas snying ga'i bam̐ yig la dbyer med du 'dres/ rdo rje khu tshur g.yon pa'i steng g.yas pa bzhag pa dril bu'i phyag rgya dang*/ ho zhes brjod pas gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dbang du gyur te byang chub bar du mi 'bral bar bsam/

zhwa lu ri zur pa'i khrid du tshar lugs pas/ pad+ma gar bskor gyi tshul du se gol gnyis nang du gtogs par gsungs pa ni/ kho rang gis de 'dra zhig gzigs pa las/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho la se gol gtogs mkhan med do// a mes zhabs kyis badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ 'di dang mdun bum gnyis kar sa mā dzaḥyod pa de dag la ni rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dgos so// de nas slar yang 'og min gyi longs sku dang*/ zhing sngags kyi sprul sku dang*/ chos kyi sku las byung ba yin pas de thams cad kyang ro gcig pa nyid yin no zhes pa'i nga rgyal bzung ba'i phyir/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsogs brjod cing rnam lnga 'dod skor sngon du 'gro ba'i 'khyud rgya bya/ de yang rnam lnga 'dod skor ni/ snying gar pad skor gcig de bzhin g.yas yang snying ga g.yon/ snying ga bcas su pad skor bya ba'o// de ltar dgos pa ni mkhan chen legs 'byung gi zin bris las/ dbus su gsum g.yas g.yon du re re'o// zhes gsungs shing kun mkhyen chen pos/ bde mchog mngal sgong sbyong tshul gyi gtor ma'i skabs oṃ yo ga sogs brjod cing rnam lnga 'dod skor bya ste brtan par bya'o// zhes gsungs pas so// sngags don ni/ rnal 'byor dag pa'i chos thams cad rnal 'byor dag pa nga'o// zhes pa ste/ dang po'i sngags skyes/ gnyis pas zhing skyes/ gsum pas lhan skyes bstan pa yin te/ bsgom pa mas sgom/ byin gyis yas rlob ces/ sngags skyes la zhing skyes kyis byin gyis rlob la/ de la lhan skyes kyis byin gyis rlob/ de la chos skus byin gyis rlob pa yin pa bla ma gong ma rnams kyis gsungs pas so// bar 'di sems 'dzin mdzad par spro na yang spyan dbus ma nas bzung ste/ rgyan med rgyan can/ ldog pa/ zab pa dang rgya che ba 'ga' 'du'i skyon med sogs thams cad khrid yig ltar byed/ bzhi pa la ngag bzlas dang yid bzlas gnyis las/ dang po ni/

sngags bzlas pa'i dgos pa gzhung gzhan du gsal zhing 'og nas cung zad 'chad par 'gyur la/ bzlas pa'i yul phreng ba las so sor mang du bshad kyang*/ 'dir mi thod kyi phreng ba nyid bsngags shing*/ grangs ni spyi dang mthun/ byin rlabs kyi cho ga yang saṃ bu ṭar 'byung ba kyai rdor gyi skabs ltar byas pas chog ste/ saṃ bu ṭa ni bde dgyes gnyis ka thun mong gi bshad rgyud yin pas so// zhwa lu ri zur pas yab ka ltar pad+ma gar dbang du bskyed par gsungs kyang*/ sa skya pa'i phyag len la yab bka'i skabs su yang 'di ltar mdzad pa ma gtogs 'od dpag med du bskyed pa'i phyag len med do// sgrub mchod kyi skabs su/ ru tsi ra ma na tshar kha shas kyis 'gyur sngags mdzad pa las byin rlabs sngon song gi dbang du btang srol yang yod/ bzlas pa dngos la yang*/ spro bsdu'i bzlas pa/ bkod pa'i bzlas pa/ rig byed 'don pa lta bu'i bzlas pa dang gsum yod kyang skabs 'dir gtso bor gzhung gi dngos bstan spro bsdu'i bzlas pa nyid yid ma yeng ba'i tshul gyis bya'o// zhi bzang dang ri zur gnyis ka'i/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyang ba gzhan don yid byed/ sangs rgyas kyis byin gyis rlabs la bdag don yid byed ces pa'i tha snyad mdzad pa ni cung zad mi legs te/ de ltar na 'phags pas mchod sems can gyi don byas zer tshad la de 'dra'i rnam bzhag byas na mkhas pa rnams bzhad mo 'chor zhing*/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi lam nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor pa la bdag don yid byed yod na shin tu tha chad pa snang ngo*// sngags don oṃ mchog ster ba gsum gyis sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub kyi mchog ster ba/ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ rdo rje'i rigs can ma'am rdo rje kha can ma/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad ma/ zhes te sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi ngo bo 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha thams cad kyi ngo bo yin pa'am/

yang na sangs rgyas thams cad dang rtag tu mnyam par sbyor ba'i mkha' 'gro ma yin pa dang*/ phyi ltar na kha dog rnam pa sna tshogs can gyi sku dang ldan zhing*/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs dang ldan pa dang*/ nang ltar na bla ma zhang bya ru bas/ rtsa ba sum cu rtsa drug gi rigs dang ldan pa'o// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ gsang ba ltar na dmar chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis/ dbu ma la rigs ldan ma zhes te/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi rigs dang ldan pa ces bya'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar nang gi skabs su rtsa spyi dang*/ gsang bar rtsa dbu ma la rigs ldan ma bshad pa'i zhar la spyi yi rigs ldan ma yang 'byung ba dang*/ gtso bor rnam par snang mdzad kyi rigs dang 'brel bas/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes sam/ me long lta bu'i ye shes gzugs sku'i rnam par snang mdzad ma yin la/ de thams cad kyang*/ mtshan ma dang rtog pas mi phyed pa'i rdo rje'i don dang ldan pa'o// hūm̐ gsum ni 'joms te sdug bsngal gsum sogs 'joms/ phaṭa gsum 'gas pa'am khos shig ste mtshan 'dzin rnam rtog thams cad khos shig swā hā gzhi tshugs ces pa'o// bar du ye gsum byung ba ni mo rtags ī nis kyi mtha' can la dgos ched kyi de byin te sgrub pa yin pas/ des na sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma'i ched du zhes sogs su 'gyur bas sngags bzla ba'i dgos pa yang sngags kyi nang nas bstan pa'o// sngags dag pa sgra yi gzhung dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sngags btu bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gtugs pa la nges dgos kyis/ dge rgan gyis dge phrug la bslab pa'i ngag sgros tsam gyi go mi chod cing byin rlabs kyang mi 'jug pas des na/ sngags btu la zhib tu sbyangs shing brgyud ldan bla ma dam pa'i zhal snga nas sngags btu'i rjes su gnang ba thob pa yang gal che'o// gnyis pa yid bzlas kyang*/ thog mar rlung ro dgu phrugs su bsal/ rlung kha sbyor bzung ste dmigs pa dkyus bzhin gyi sngags rlung gyis thub tshad par bzla ba'o// 'di mtshan bcas kyi rdzogs rim du yang bzhed do// yang rang gi smin mtshams su bde ba'i ngo bo dga' 'khyil dkar po g.yon skor shugs drag tu 'khor ba dang*/

gsang gnas su yang drod kyi ngo bo dga' 'khyil dmar po gsal btab/ lte ba'i sngags phreng mi dmigs par bzhag ste chos 'byung gi grwa bzhi'i dga' 'khyil drag tu 'khor ba bcas la sems gtad de/ rlung kha sbyor bzung ba'i mthar dga' 'khyil gnyis snying ga'i bam̐ yig la thim par bsam pa ni zhar byung gi rdzogs rim dngos so// yig brgya dang rten 'brel snying po lan gsum tsam res sngags phreng brtan par byas/ phreng ba thal mo'i bar du bzung ste/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur du phyag rgya chen mo mchog gi dngos grub rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phangs tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ gzhung 'dir rjes chog gi rjes su bsam mi khyab gsungs kyang skabs 'dir mdzad pa a mes dang thar paṇa sogs kyi yig char gsal zhing*/ tshar chen rin po ches nye lam du yang skabs 'dir bzlas pa la thug gi bar gsungs kyang*/ mjug tu gshegs gsol bya/ dam tshig pa rnams rang la thim rang gi gnas rnams su zla ba'i sogs gsungs pas skabs 'dir mdzad pa legs shing*/ gzhan yang kun gzigs mkhyen brtse rin po che la sgrub brtson bla ma dam pa lha rgyal yon tan phun tshogs nas dris pa'i lan du yang*/ rgyud sde gzhan dang sgo bstun nas kyang 'dir bsam mi khyab kyi bsdu rim mdzad par bzhed pa ni shin tu legs pas/ de ltar na rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros khams gsum thams cad khyab ces sogs brjod cing gsal btab cing 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi bar du bsdu/ de yang gzugs med mu bzhi la yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus tsam las med pas yid thugs rdo rje'i kha dog dang mthun par 'od du zhu ba dang*/ gzugs khams gtso bor sgra yi skye mched shugs che bar gnas pa'i gsung rdo rje'i kha dog dang mthun pa dang*/

'dod khams la skye mched thams cad yod pas kha dog dkar por zhu ba yin zhes kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos gsungs so// mthar rang skad cig gi thun mtshams kyi lha rdo rje rnal 'byor mar bzhengs pa la/ go cha dran tsam bya ba'am ma byas kyang chog ste de dag gis ni bdag bskyed kyi gnad cung zad bstan zin to// de dag gi don tshigs su bcad na/ bdag lus phung khams skye mched rtswa spur tshogs// sngags phreng bam̐ gyi byin za rab 'bar bas// nyer bsreg khams gsum khyab pa'i 'od zer gyis// gong bu gcig tu 'dril de bskyod pa'i rten// de las byi ru'i lhun por mtshan dpe yi// grogs ldan shin tu yid 'ong dpal mo'i sku// 'jigs byed pho mo brdzis pa'i rnam 'gyur can// bskyed pas tha mal snang zhen dbyings su brtul// rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rdo rje slob dpon ni// rnam par snang mdzad ngo bor bsgyur byas te// gang gi dbu rgyan byas pa'i ngo mtshar la// 'khor bsgyur gser sbyang cod pan ga la 'gran// rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dngos ak+ṣa ras// rab dkar chu shel me long ngos shar ba// lte sogs gnas su thogs pas phyi nang gis// bgegs dang bar chad bsrung ba'i go cha grub// sngags phreng las 'phros 'od zer dngul chu yis// rigs drug yid can lcags khams ma lus kyang*// rnam byang dag pa'i gser du bsgyur ba des// ma rgan 'gro la phan pa cis mi 'grub// ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i phyag rgya sngags bcas kyis/ khab len rdo yi lcags kyi phye ma bzhin// gnas gsum pho nya mo rnams thams cad kyang*// rang gi lus la bsdu 'di e ma rmad// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yang snying sngags kyi sgra// ma g.yeng sems dang lhan cig sgrogs pa las// rdo rje'i rnal 'byor bye ba phrag brgya yang*// chu gter dbus su sprin gyi me tog bzhin// rlung sbyor kun gyi thu bo kha sbyor gyi// gling bur rgyal kun gsang ba'i tshig sbyar te// gang gis lag par thogs pa de nyid la// brtse bas mi gzigs rnam 'dren ri skyes su// bde stong ngo bo dga' ba 'khyil ba zung*// bde chen gnas gnyis gsal btab ting 'dzin mthus// bsam gtan dang po pham byed bde ba dang*// gtum mo'i drod kyis yid rab tshim par nus/

khams gsum 'ja' tshon mkha' la yal ba ltar// rang lus la thim de yang 'od gsal gyis// rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i zung 'jug phyag rgya che// yid bzhin nor bu lag par thob par gyur// slar yang mtha' yas ma rnams bsgral ba'i slad// mtshan dpe sgyu ma'i zlos gar shar ba'i mod// go cha'i lha sngags chu las chu bur ltar// gsal rdzogs dbyer med cho 'phrul cir yang mdzes// ma dag phung po khams dang skye mched tshogs// ma lus ye shes ngo bo legs bsgom pas// ma gyur 'gro ba'i don chen rdo rje 'chang*// ma 'bad tshe 'di nyid la mngon du 'gyur// ces kyang gleng ngo*// gnyis pa mdun bskyed sgrub cing mchod pa la/ gang la mchod pa'i yul gsal btab pa/ de la mchod pa'i tshul dngos gnyis las/ dang po la/ nang mchod dang bdud rtsi byin gyis brlab pa/ dkyil 'khor rnam gsum stabs gcig tu rten dang brten pa'i lhar bskyed pa/ de nyid la dbang bskur zhing rgyas gdab pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni bsang sbyangs sngon du btang ste/ snod kyi 'og tu yaṃ las rlung*/ de'i steng raṃ las me/ de'i steng snod a las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du a las zla ba'i steng*/ go ku da ha na las sha lnga/ bi ra shu ma mu las bdud rtsi lnga/ hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ am̐ dz+rī kham̐ ye shes lnga rnams kyi steng gi nam mkhar oṃ dkar po mgo thur bstan/ de'i steng a las zla dkyil/ de'i steng hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros rlung la phog g.yos/ me sbar/ rdzas dang yig 'bru bcas zhu bskol gyi rlangs pas steng gi oṃ dang zla ba sna tshogs rdo rje bcas bskul te/ de dag las bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag yang hūm̐ gi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i rnam par spyan drangs/ thod pa thod pa dang bdud rtsi bdud rtsi la thim/

oṃ zla ba rdo rje bcas lhung 'od du zhu gcig tu 'dres nas/ kha dog dag pa'i shel ltar dang dri dang ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsam ste gong sngon 'gro'i skabs su bshad pa'i phyag rgya bcas oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥlan gsum brjod 'dir 'don bya bsdus kyang bsgom don 'di bzhin dgos nges te 'jam mgon a mes kyi cho ga las kyang 'di ltar bde mchog sor bzhag tu mdzad 'dug pas so// gnyis pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gsum ka la bsang sbyangs lhan cig tu stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las byung ba'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu bdungs pa lta bu rgyan nam ba dan gyis mtshan pa mdog sngon po/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa dmar po/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po grwa bzhir rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du suṃ las ri yi rgyal po ri rab shar shel/ lho baiḍūr+ya/ nub pad+ma rā ga byang gser las grub pa/ zur bzhi pa/ rtse mor lcog brgyad dang ldan pa de'i steng du a las ye shes kyi kā pā la yangs shing rgya che ba bdud rtsi lngas yongs su gang ba de'i steng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje shar sngo sogs phyogs mdog can gyi lte bar hūm̐ de las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin can dang*/ khor yug rdo rje nag po rwa gdengs pa 'greng bu'i rwa ba/ de lta bu 'phred la sogs pa'i drwa ba/ steng du rdo rje'i gur dang*/ de'i 'og nas sham bu dang bcas pa'i rdo rje'i bla re/ de dag gi phyi rol tu mda'i drwa ba mde'u rtse bsnol ba phyir bstan pa srid pa'i rtse mo la thug pa/ de'i phyi rol tu bskal ba'i me 'bar ba lta bu'i me ri kha dog sna tshogs rab tu 'bar ba'i nang der/

gtum drag dang tshang tshang 'khrigs pa la sogs pa'i dur khrod brgyad du/ brgya byin dang gnod sbyin la sogs pa'i phyogs skyong brgyad/ shrī sha/ a shwad tha sogs shing brgyad/ de dag la brten cing sgo mtshams ma rnams kyi gzugs 'dzin pa'i drag gtum skyong ba sogs zhing skyong brgyad/ nor rgyas dang 'jog po sogs klu brgyad/ sprang grag pa/ rmugs pa sogs sprin brgyad/ chu brgyad/ me brgyad/ mchod rten brgyad/ gzhan yang sprul pa dang rang rgyud pa'i dpa' bo dpa' mo grub pa/ rig 'dzin/ mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro ma/ 'dre srin po/ gnod sbyin/ sha za/ 'byung po ce spyang sogs kyis gang ba dang bcas pa'i dbus su e e las chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs bskyed pa'i lte bar bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ sems can thams cad kyi sgrib sbyang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur byas/ tshur 'dus sngags phreng bam̐ yig dang bcas pa la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa ni/ phyogs bzhi dmar/ me rlung ser/ dbang ldan ljang*/ bden bral nag pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan ni 'khor bar sems can gyi don mdzad kyang nyes skyon gyis mi gos par mtshon/ de'i steng me shel gyi rang bzhin nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor maṇ+ḍal kha sbub pa'i dbyibs can pad+ma'i lte ba dang mnyam pa ni rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'am/ byang chub kyi sems kyi myu gu 'phel zhing smin pa mtshon byed/ yang na pad+mas thabs dang*/ nyi mas shes rab/ de gnyis brtsegs pa ni zung du 'jug pa'o// zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i tshul ni snying rjes sems can gyi don la 'jug par mtshon/ dus mtshan ma dmar mo gri thod bzung ba 'dod chags kyi gnas nu ma'i steng nas mgo g.yas phyogs su bstan nas mnan pa ni 'dod chags rnam par dag pa mtshon/

zhabs g.yon bskum pa ni zhi ba myang 'das kyi sa la mi gnas par mtshon/ des 'jigs byed nag po lag pa bzhi pa/ g.yas ḍā ru dang gri gug g.yon thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga thogs pa/ gti mug gi gnas mgo bo rgyab phyogs su bltabs te kha sbub tu mnan pas/ zhe sdang dag par mtshon te/ nges brjod las/ 'jigs byed dang ni dus mtshan dag /chags pa zhe sdang zhabs kyis mnan// zhes gsungs la/ 'jigs byed rtag pa 'khor mtha' zhabs g.yon par shes rab kyis mnan/ dus mtshan chad pa myang 'das kyi mtha' g.yas thabs kyi rang bzhin gyis mnan pa yang bshad do// mnan bya de yang ro lta bu ma yin pa dngos su mnan par bzhed/ snying rje chen pos sems can la rjes su chags par mtshon pa'i phyir sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar zhing gdugs pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i phyir bskal pa tha ma'i me ltar 'bar ba'i gzi brjid dang ldan pa ste/ nges brjod las/ sku ni nyi ma brgya yi gzi// sku mdog gzi brjid dang mtshungs pa// me tog ban+dhu ka lta bu// zhes gsungs/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib g.yog dang bral ba mtshon pa'i sku gcer bu/ chos nyid de bzhin nyid du ro gcig pas zhal gcig bden pa gnyis kyi rang bzhin thugs su chud pa'i brdar phyag gnyis ma/ gzigs par bya ba khams gsum la gzigs shing mkhyen par bya ba dus gsum gcig char du mkhyen la/ brnyes par bya ba sku gsum gyi go 'phangs mngon du gyur pas spyan gsum dag pa mkha' spyod kyi zhing du gzigs shing sgrub pa po rnams brtson pa bskyed na myur du 'di lta bu'i zhing khams la khrid par mdzad par mtshon/ phyag g.yas pas 'khor ba'i skyon thams cad gcod par byed pa'i brdar rdo rje gri gug ste rdo rje rtse lnga pa phyed pa'i yu ba byas pa'i gri gug sor brgyad dam bcu gnyis pa 'jol thabs su bsnams pa/ phyag g.yon pas bde chen gyi ye shes brnyes pa'i brdar zla ba ltar dkar ba'i thod pa bdud bzhi'i khrag bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can gyis gang ba steng phyogs su bzung nas zhal gyen du phyogs pas gsol ba/

phrag pa g.yon na shes rab kyi phyogs mtshon par thabs bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin kha ṭ+wāṃ ga yod pa ste/ de yang gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chos thams cad mtshon nus pas lus tshad dang mnyam pa/ yu ba dkar po brgyad gzhogs kyis lam gyi yan lag brgyad mtshon/ rtsa ba rdo rje rtse lnga pas ma dag pa'i 'gro ba rgyud lnga mtshon/ gyen du 'phel kha che zhing sbom du song ba ni lam gyi yon tan gong nas gong du 'phel bar mtshon/ sna tshogs rdo rje bum pa thod pa skam rlon rnyid gsum rdo rje rtse lnga pa sgang po dang bcas pa ni thabs dang shes rab zung du chud pa'i sems can gyi don 'bad med du 'grub par mtshon/ ḍā ma ru dang dril bu dang ba dan rtse gsum pa 'phyang nas yu ba mdun dang rtse mo rgyab la bstan nas phrag par bkal pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa'am/ yang na kha ṭ+wāṃ gas lha'i sku/ ḍā ru dang g.yer khas gsung*/ 'phan rtse gsum pas thugs rnam thar sgo gsum dang ldan par mtshon pas yab sku gsung thugs dang bcas pa mtshon/ las kyi rdo rje phyed pas bsrung ba'i 'khor lo/ rkang brgyad gzhogs kyi dur khrod brgyad/ sna tshogs rdo rjes gzhal yas khang*/ thod pa gsum gyis sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo/ bum pas bde chen gyi 'khor lo/ steng gi rdo rje phyed pa tog tu bzhed pa'i lugs kyang yod la/ de bzhin du brten pa lha yang*/ steng gi rdo rje gtso bo/ rnal 'byor ma rang nyid yum/ bum pas snying po rnal 'byor ma bzhi bum thod dang bcas pa/ mi mgo gsum gyis thugs gsung sku'i lha tshogs bzhi bcu zhe brgyad/ sna tshogs rdo rjes sgo mtshams ma brgyad mtshon pa'o// gzhan yang sna tshogs rdo rjes phrin las sgrub pa'i sprul sku/ bum pas longs sku bde ba chen po thod pa gsum gyi rnam thar sgo gsum gyi rang bzhin chos sku mtshon/ steng gi rdo rje rtse lngas sku gsum po re re yang ye shes lnga lnga'i bdag nyid can du bstan la/

der ma zad/ sna tshogs rdo rjes bum dbang*/ bum pas gsang dbang*/ thod skam gyis sher dbang*/ steng gi rdo rjes dbang bzhi pa mtshon no// dbu skra nag po ma 'dzings shing ma 'khrug par grol pa sil bur gyur pas sku sked yan chad khebs pa ni gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa thams cad las grol ba'i mtshon byed dang*/ dga' ba bcu drug rgyas pa'i brdar lo bcu drug lon pa ltar lang tsho dar la bab cing*/ bde chen gyi ye shes rgyas pa'i brdar 'dod pa'i nu 'bur rgyas pa/ gsang ba'i pad+ma rus sbal gyi rgyab ltar mtho ba sogs kyis bde ba bskyed pa'i nyam can/ rgyal ba rigs lnga mtshon cing de re re'ang ye shes lnga ldan du mtshon phyir mi yi thod pa leb mor byas pa sor lnga pa'i tshad la rgya tshos kyis kha mig gtod pa'i steng du rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan sogs kyis spras shing rus pa'i 'khyud mos bsdam pa'i dbu rgyan dang*/ nang gi khams lnga bcu dag pa'i thod skam lnga bcu ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i ro skra la brgyus pa'i do shal phrag pa nas brla'i bar du 'phyang ba/ de yang yum shes rab kyi rang bzhin la byang sems kyi mtshon don thams cad skam gyi brgyan pa yin/ spyi bor bsam gtan gyi phar phyin gyi ngo bo rus pa'i 'khor lo/ snyan gnyis la bzod pa'i rang bzhin rus pa'i a long*/ mgul du sbyin pa'i ngo bo mgul rgyan/ yan lag rnams la tshul khrims mtshon byed kyi gdu bu/ rked par brtson 'grus kyi phar phyin dag pa'i 'og pags sam rus pa'i rked rgyan/ mchod phyir thogs shes rab kyi rang bzhin yin pas skabs 'dir mi dgos pas phyag rgya lnga'o// de dag phyin drug dang sbyar ba ni bde mchog rang gi lugs te/ rtsa rgyud las/ pha rol phyin drug rgyan drug sogs// zhes gsungs/ de lta'i sku'i rnam 'gyur mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba snang la rang bzhin med pa'i rnam pa sku las 'phros pa'i ye shes kyi me ru ltar 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsam mo// de nas spyan drangs pa dang*/

ye shes pa bstim pa dang*/ go cha 'god pa bcas la pho nya gsum bsre med pa ma gtogs gzhan bdag bskyed kyi skabs ltar bya/ slar yang rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis dbang lha bde mchog gi lha thams cad spyan drangs par bsam ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas 'og bdag 'jug gi skabs kyi dmigs pa dang mthun par mdun bskyed la dbang bskur bas dbang gi chu rgyun gyi sku lus gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi gtsug tu rnam snang he ru ka dkar po 'khor lo dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa spyi bor 'khor lo dkar pos mtshan pa zhig gis dbur brgyan par bsam mo// 'di'i skabs kyi dag rgyu'i dri ma ni mchod yul la dri ma'i skyon med kyang*/ rang ngos nas tha mal du snang ba dang*/ gya nom lhar zhen dang dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis su snang zhing bzang ngan du rnam par rtog pa'i dri ma de yin zhes kun gzigs 'jam pa'i rdo rjes gsungs pa yang 'thad do snyam/ dbang lha yang mdun bskyed la bstim pa'o// 'di dag tshigs su bcad na/ stong gsal dag pa'i lha yi lam yangs dang*// 'gran nus bde ba skyong ba'i snod chen por// lnga phrag gsum gyi snying po bzhu skol gyis// lha yi bdud rtsi'i ngo bo zil gyis mnan//
