'byung ba rnam bzhi ri rab thod pa'i steng*// mi shig srung 'khor ro ldan gnas bcas dbus// sna tshogs pad+ma nyin byed brtsegs pa las// gnas bcas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dpal ni// rā ga'i ri bo rta bdun zer phreng gis// dam 'khyud yid la dga' ba'i mchog sbyin pa// dgra thub sde bcas gcig tu bzlum pa'i gzugs/ kho na'i khyad par chos las gzhan du gang*// mi shes smag tu shes rab glog phreng 'khyugs// zhi ba'i grong bzhugs zhi bde'i bsam pa btang*// brtse ba chen pos brtse yul rjes su bzung*// mkha' spyod ma ste mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo'ang lags// gcig tu snang yang dkyil 'khor du ma'i yum// zhi bar ston kyang gdug can khrag la rol// chags pa spang yang bde la chags pa'i tshul// srid las 'das kyang 'gro ba'i blo dang bstun// tshe thung gcig gis zung 'jug thob byed thabs// grogs dag las gzhan thong la tshul 'dir zhugs// tshe 'di'i rgyal thabs thob phyir 'bad pa las// gtan gyi don phyir 'di nyid khyad par 'phags// rigs kyi bdag po rje btsun 'khor lo'i mgon// gang gi bde chen gnas su bsti ba la// bde gshegs kun gyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen la// gus pas bsten par gyis zhes bskul ba bzhin// zab zab gzhung 'di'i lam srol ches zab zab// zab zab nā ro ta pa'i thugs zab zab// zab zab spros pa bral ba'i dbyings zab zab// zab zab nyams blang 'bras bu rab zab zab// ces so// gnyis pa ni/

bde mchog gi gzhung 'di'i mchod pa'i rnam grangs la mkhas pa rnams bzhed tshul mi 'dra ba du ma snang yang skabs 'dir rje btsun rin po ches/ bdag gi mngon par rtogs pa bar ma'i skabs su/ gsang sngags kyi mchod pa dang*/ phyi'i mchod pa dang*/ bdud rtsi'i mchod pa dang*/ mnyes pa'i mchod pa dang*/ yid las byung ba'i mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa'i mchod pa ste drug po 'ba' zhig byed pa yin la/ tshes bcu'i mchod pa la sogs pa'i dus su ni phyi mchod kyi rjes su rig ma bcu drug dang*/ rin chen sna bdun dang*/ 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa ste gsum bsnan nas dbul ba'i mchod pa byed pa yin no// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ skabs 'dir yang sngags mchod ma gtogs pa'i brgyad po mdzad cing de dag kyang rigs bsdu ba'i dbang du byas na phyi yi mchod pa/ nang gi mchod pa/ yid byung gi mchod pa/ bstod pa'i mchod pa ste bzhi las/ dang po la nyer spyod kyi mchod pa zhar byung dang bcas pa dang*/ rig ma bcu drug gis mchod pa/ rin chen sna bdun/ 'dod don lnga ste bzhi las/ dang po la mchod yul spyan drangs pa dang*/ mchod pa dngos so// dang po ni/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can la brgyud pa'i bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma yi dam chos skyong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba bdag gzhan sems can thams cad tshogs rdzogs pa'i phyir du mchod pa'i yul du mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang*/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs te/ mdun bskyed kyi steng gi cha la rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyis mtshon tshogs zhing thams cad sa dang bar snang gi khams thams cad bar mtshams med par gang bar bzhugs par bsam pa ni tshogs zhing khyad par ba gsal btab pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ skabs 'dir mar me sogs kyang sbar te/ bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las a bdun las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba bdun gyi nang du hūm̐ bdun zhu ba las lha yi rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon sogs nye bar spyod pa bdun dang*/

gzhan yang rnga dang rol mo ḍā ma ru dang dril bu'i mtshon pa'i rol mo rnams kyang zab gsal gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin dwangs shing thogs pa med pa gcig las kyang brgya stong sogs nas grangs med pa'i bar du 'phros te nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par bsam la/ rtsa ba'i rlung lnga dang yan lag gi rlung lnga dbu mar thim pa'i rten 'brel du rdo rje thal mo zhes sor mo rnams phan tshun bsnol ba'i thal mo sbyar zhing*/ bla med kyi skabs thams cad du thal mo 'di nyid nges par sbyar dgos zhes bdag gi bla ma ngag gi dbang po bzhed do// gang ltar yang tshig bcad rnams gdangs dang bcas brjod cing don ni/ de yang gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla dang bcas pa gcig tu bgrang ba stong ni stong dang po'i 'jig rten yin la/ de gcig tu brtsis pa stong ni bar ma'i 'jig rten/ de gcig tu brtsis pa stong ni stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams zhes su grags la de lta bu'i 'jig rten gyi khams mi 'jed 'di'am/ der ma zad 'di lta bu'i stong gsum gyi 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan dag na yang*/ lha yi yo byad las grub pa'i rdzas gaṅgā dang sin dhu dang*/ pak+ṣu sī ta la sogs pa gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba'i chu yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams kyang*/ rigs brgya'i khyab bdag dngos grub rnam gnyis kyi 'byung khungs drin can rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang*/ rgyal yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dbyer med pa gzhan yang sangs rgyas byang sems kyi tshogs thams cad la 'bul ba lags na/ yul dam pa khyed rnams skom pa sogs kyi nyes skyon las grol ba yin kyang*/ bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i dus nas thugs rje chen pos sems can rnams rjes su bzung ba'i dam bca' ji ltar mdzad pa bsnyel ba med par bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba rnams tshogs rdzogs pa'i don gyi phyir du bzhes su gsol/

zhes dang*/ yid kyis rang gi snying ga nas mchod pa'i lha mo mdzes sdug dang ldan pa rgyan gyis spras pa/ snyan pa'i glu dang*/ bde ba'i gar bsgyur ba sha stag gis/ dus gsum gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad mchod rdzas su gyur te/ yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chu la sman sna tshogs btab pa'i mchod yon gyis gang ba'i dung phor thogs pa gcig las brgya sogs nas grangs med pa'i bar du spros te mchod yul rnams kyi zhal du phul bas mnyes par bsam la/ sngags kyang brjod/ sngags don ni/ oṃ skabs 'dir dam bca' ba ste mchod par bya ba dam bca' ba/ sarba ta thā ga ta de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad/ ces pa ste chos nyid de bzhin nyid gzigs shing gshegs pa'i kha sbyor bdun ldan gyi sangs rgyas/ cho ga phal cher lha yi mtshan sngags med par 'di ltar 'byung ba ni khyab che zhing gtso 'khor thams cad kyang bde bar gshegs pa gcig gi ye shes kyi rol par shes pa'i ched du yin no// sarba wī ra yo gi ni dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor thams cad ces pa ste de las kyang bye brag tu bla ma rje btsun rdo rje chos dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nyid gtso bor smros pa'o// sa pā ri wā ra/ 'khor dang bcas pa/ ar+ghaṃ mchod yon/ pra tīts+tsha/ so sor bzhes/ pū dza me gha sa mu dra/ mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtsho/ s+pha ra ṇa rgyas pa/ sa ma ye/ dam tshig gi ched du/ āḥhūm̐/ gsung dang thugs kyi sa bon te de nyid gsum dang spel ba'o// rgyas pa ni rgya che ba dang*/ dam tshig gi ched du/ sems can gyi don mdzad pa zhal gyis bzhes pa'i don yin no// phyag rgya ni gong du bshad pa'i rnam lnga 'dod skor gyi phyag rgya sngon du 'gro bas ar+ghaṃ zhes pa dang mchod yon gyi phyag rgya rdo rje khu tshur la gung mo gshib te bsgreng ba'i tshul/ pra tīts+tsha'i skabs su se gol snying ga'i thad nas kha phyir bstan/ āḥhūm̐ gi skabs kha nang du bstan nas gdab pa/

rnam lnga 'dod skor gyis mchod lha rnams kyi gar mtshon/ mchod pa'i phyag rgyas mchod pa/ se gol phar gtogs pas mchod lha spro/ tshur gtogs pas mchod lha rang gi snying gar bsdu ba ste rlung sems dbu mar 'du ba'i rten 'brel yod gsungs pas/ des na sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gsum ka dang ma bral ba zhig dgos pa yin pas gsar bu dag dang mtshan nyid theg par zhen 'thas kyi rigs phal cher cho ga 'don pa kho na las phyag rgya rang la dgos don de tsam med do snyam pa'i log rtog kyang 'dis ldog pa yin no// dmigs pa gzhan de dang mthun pa la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ rin po che'i snod bzang por zhabs bsil ba'i chu dri ma med cing dang ba du ma/ me tog kha dog sna tshogs pa sil mar gtor ba'am phreng bar spel ba ma rnying ba rnam pa sna tshogs dang*/ nor bu'i spos snod du tsan+dan dang*/ a ka ru la sogs pa'i dri zhim po dang ldan pa'i spos kyi rengs bu dang phye ma me dang sbyar ba'i du ba'i sprin nam mkha' khyab pa/ gser la sogs pa'i snod du 'bri mar dang rtsi mar sogs kyis bkang ste me sbar ba'i 'od kyis 'jig rten gsum po ma lus pa gsal bar nus pa'i snang gsal/ chu gtsang ma la ga bur dang gur gum sogs dri bzang pos sbags pa'i dri chab/ kha zas ro brgya dang ldan pa'i tshogs bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i zhal zas/ gong du smos pa'i rol mo dang gzhan yang pi waṃ dang gling bu sogs snyan 'gyur dang ldan pa'i rol mo'i sgra dang bcas 'bul ba yin la/ lha mo yang mchod yon ma sngon mo/ zhabs bsil ma dkar mo/ me tog ma dkar mo/ bdug spos ma sngon mo/ mar me ma dmar skya'am dmar mo/ dri chab ma ljang gu/ zhal zas ma dkar mo/ sgra ma sngon mor bskyed pa'am/ ar+ghaṃ/ pād+yaṃ/ shāb+da bcas la lha mo mi spro bar/ gzhan rnams la lha mo spro ba'i phyag len zhig kyang yod la/ bdag gi bla ma rdo rje 'chang ngag gi dbang pos/

mchod sngags la mo rtags kyi rkyen byin pa puṣ+pe sogs la mchod lha spro/ skabs 'gar puṣ+pe sogs ma ning gi rtags can 'byung ba la mchod pa spro ba yin gsungs pa gnyis gnad gcig par snang bas so// sngags don rnams ni go sla la/ phyag rgya ni zhabs bsil dang mchod yon 'dra/ rdo rje khu tshur kha gyen bstan ni me tog de gnyis kha thur bstan bdug pa/ mthe bong gnyis gshibs te bsgreng ba mar me/ rdo rje khu tshur kha mdun bskyed la bstan te byug pa'i tshul lam/ sor mo rnams gyen du bsgrengs te byug pa'i tshul ni dri chab/ thal mo gnyis kha phyes nas bzed pa'i tshul ni zhal zas/ se gol gtogs pa ni rol mo'i phyag rgya zhes bshad kyang mdun bskyed skabs rol mo dngos su bkrol ba nyid yin la skabs 'dir ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi brjod pa yang rol mo dbul ba'i ched du yin no// zhar byung na bza' 'bul ba ni/ gos bzung bshams te/ bsangs sbyangs/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i lha'i gos pañca li ka kha dog sna tshogs pa srab pa/ 'jam pa yang ba/ zung du sbyar ba'i rang bzhin du bsam zhing*/ tshigs bcad brjod/ de'i don ni/ kha dog lta na sdug pa dang ldan pas bzang zhing ga bur dang gur gum sogs dri zhim pos bgos pa/ reg na bde ba bskyed pa/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma ltar srab pa/ rtsub pa'i reg bya dang bral bas 'jam pa/ shing bal ltar yang la mdzes pa lha las byung ba'i na bza' mchog 'di bgres rgud dang bral ba rdo rje lta bu'i sku can rnams la 'bul ba la brten nas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyang bgres pa med pa rdo rje lta bu'i sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa thob par shog ces dang mchod pa'i lha mo na bza' thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te lha rnams la stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs zung re phul bar bsam/ sngags don gzhan 'dra/ badz+ra was+t+ra ya/ rdo rje'i gos zhes pa ste sra zhing 'khreg pa rdo rje lta bu'i gos zhes sam/

yang na bla med kyi skabs 'dir yul dang bya ba gang la yang rdo rje'i sgra sbyar ba yod kyis/ la la dag rdo rje'i ri mo can zhes kyang bshad de shes byed med do// phyag rgya ni gos bzung btegs te smad g.yogs gsol ba'i tshul dang*/ de nyid stod phyogs nas bsgyur ste stod g.yogs phul ba'i tshul bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas rdo rje lha mo bcu drug rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs par spros te/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 'khor dang bcas pa mchod par bsam ste/ rdo rje lha mo pi waṃ ma sogs brjod de/ de'i don cung zad bshad na/ pi waṃ sogs bzhi/ bzhad sogs bzhi/ me tog ma sogs bzhi/ gzugs sogs bzhi ste bcu drug go /'di dag la grangs mi 'dra ba du ma zhig 'byung yang bde mchog gi skabs 'dir 'di nyid mdzad la/ gzhan dag las rol mo'i lha mo bzhi/ kun rig gi skabs kyi sgeg sogs brgyad/ rdo rje ma bzhi rnams byed pa yang 'dod snam la 'god pa'i skabs sogs su mdzad pa dang*/ yang phyi yi lha mo brgyad nang gi lha mo bzhi/ gsang ba'i lha mo bzhi sogs bzhed srol du ma yod kyang rgyud sde rang rang la rang rang gi lugs sbyar ba nyid 'thad che'o// gang ltar yang tshigs su bcad pa gcig gi don bshad na thams cad la khyab che bas legs par bshad par bya'o// de yang rgyud las/ rdo rje mi phyed ces byar brjod// ces dang*/ sra zhing snying po khong stong med// bcad pa byar med gzhig med pa// stong nyid rdo rje ces byar brjod// ces gsungs pa ltar chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba'i stong nyid mtshan ma dang rnam par rtogs pas mi phyed pa de nyid la rdo rje zhes brjod cing de nyid skabs 'dir yid du 'ong ba'i tshe phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i gzugs 'dzin pa'i lha mo/ dar sna tshogs kyi gos dang rin po che'i rgyan du mas mdzes par byas pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo'i rnam par shar bas na rdo rje lha mo/

de la mtshan gang zhe na/ pi waṃ ma zhes te rgyal ba thams cad kyi yon tan brjod pa'i glu dang sbyar ba'i pi waṃ brdung ba la mkhas pas so// mdog ci lta bu zhe na/ ston ka ste 'bras bu dang ldan pa'i dus kyi sprin med pa'i nam mkha'i mdog mtshungs pa/ phyag mtshan gang bsnams na rgyud mang po dang ldan pa'i baiḍūr+ya'i pi waṃ lag g.yon par thogs cing g.yas pas sor mos skad snyan par bsgyur bar byed pa/ mchod pa'i tshul ji ltar na de lta bu'i pi waṃ sgra dang lhan cig tu/ 'gyur khug phra sbom 'degs 'jog drug dang sbyar ba'i dbyangs dang ldan pa'i sgo nas so// de yang gcig kho na ma yin pa gcig las bcu/ bcu las brgya sogs nam mkha'i khams thams cad yongs su gang bar sems kyis sprul te/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad la tshul bzhin du mchod par bgyi'o// zhes dang*/ mtshan sngags gong bzhin la/ oṃ badz+ra wi nī rdo rje pi waṃ ma/ hūm̐ gis spros hūm̐ rjes mas bsdus/ phaṭa ces pas mchod pa'i yul dang mchod pa po lha mo dang bcas pa gnyis su 'dzin pa dang bral ba'i don la blo bzhag pa ste/ gzhung gzhan las don dam mchod pa bstan pa rnams dang tshul 'dra'o// phyag rgya yang snying ga dang nu ma g.yas g.yon gyi thad du pad skor re re byed pa gar skor sngon du 'gro ba'i lag pa g.yon pa'i thal mo gyen du blangs/ g.yas kyi khu tshur gyis pi waṃ sgreng tshul byed pas mthar se gol gnyis re gong bzhin btab na dmigs pa gsal zhing bla ma dag gi phyag bzhes kyang yin la bde mchog dang*/ a mes kyi cho ga'i skabs thog mar oṃ/ nī badz+ra hūm̐ āḥzhes spros nas mchod pa'i tshigs bcad dang sngags kyi mthar bsdu ba ltar na sngags gong ma la se gol gcig dang*/ 'og ma la gcig btab pa 'byung ngo*// yi ge rnying par ston ka'i mdog ces cung ma dag par snang ste/ ston ka dus yin pas de la mdog yod par sus kyang khas len mi nus pas/

des na ston mkha' zhes 'don pa dang bri ba gnyis ka dag ste/ bde mchog tu dbang sngon mdog mtshungs zhes in+d+ra nī la'i mdog tu bshad pa dang mthun no// de nas lhag ma rnams kyi mtshan don/ kha dog phyag mtshan sngags don phyag rgya rnams mthar chags su bkod de/ snyan pa'i skad dang ldan pa'i gling bu'i sgra sgrogs par mdzad ma/ gser mdog bde mchog gi yi ger gser zangs mdog ni yig nor ste gser zangs kyi mdog ni dmar ser lta bur yod pa la/ 'di ni btso ma'i gser dang ba'i mdog lta bu yin dgos pas/ gser bzang zhes su 'thad do// gser sogs las grub pa'i gling bu thogs shing phyag gnyis kyis snyan par bsgyur ba/ waṃ s+ya ni gling bu ma/ lag gnyis kyi sor mo g.yas phyogs su gling bu bsgyur tshul byed/ chos kyi dbyings kun nas zlum pa'i rang gzugs mngon sum du bstan pas na rnga zlum pa/ me tog sin+dhu dzī ba ka zhes kha mdog dmar po de'i mdog dang mtshungs par rked par rnga zlum po btags pa lag pa gnyis kyis dbyu gu thung ngu thogs te brdung ba/ mṛ taṃ ge rnga zlum ma/ phyag rgya yang g.yas g.yon nas phan tshun res mos kyis brdung tshul/ rgyal ba thams cad kyang gang la gang 'dul gyi tshul gyis chos kyang zab mi zab sna tshogs bstan par mtshon pa'i phyir skad che chung dang bcas pa'i rdza rnga 'dzin pas na rdza rnga ma/ margad de rgya gar gyi skad du mar ka ta zhes pa zur chags pa ste rin po che mdog ljang gu zhig yod pa de'i kha dog can rked pa'i thad g.yas g.yon du lhung bzed kyi dbyibs can gyi rnga bod kyi skad phal par darma grags pa thogs nas steng nas res mos 'degs 'jog sna tshogs kyis brdung ba/ murdzi rdza rnga ma sngags rgya yang de nyid do// 'di gnyis bde mchog dang gong bsnol 'dug kyang tha snyad 'dogs tshul tsam las/ de la 'gal ba cher med do// rgyal ba sras bcas kyi yon tan la rab tu dga' ba dang sems can gyi don la spro ba'i sgo nas bzhad par mdzad pas na bzhad pa mo/

ke shu ste rgya skyegs kyi me tog gi mdog dang ldan pa/ phyag mtshan ni lag pa'i thal mo 'gram pa'i phan tshun du rdo rje thog pa dang bcas brkyang zhing bzhad pa'i zhal dang ldan pa/ ha se bzhad pa ma/ phyag rgya rdo rje khu tshur kha 'gram g.yas g.yon du bzhag pa'o// sangs rgyas thams cad thugs zhi ba chen po'i dbyings la 'gying bar mtshon pa'i sku lus kyang 'gyings shing rab tu sgeg pas na sgeg pa mo// dbang sngon te in+d+ra nī la'i mdog can rdo rje thog pa'i phyag gnyis dku g.yas g.yon du bsten cing 'gying ba/ snyems pa'i lus 'gying ba'i don yin la/ lā s+ye sgeg mo/ phyag rgya yang de bzhin no// rgyal ba'i gsung rnam pa thams cad pa sems can gyi khams la yang dag par 'dom pa'i don can gyi glu len pas na glu dbyangs ma/ nyi ma 'char ka'i dus kyi shar phyogs nags mo sprin gyi mdog dang mtshungs pa ste/ bde mchog las/ gur gum gsung ba dang don gcig sku lus kyis pi waṃ sogs kyi rol mo dkrol pa dang lhan cig tu zhal nas rgyal ba'i yon tan brjod pa sogs kyi glu len ma/ gī tī/ glu ma/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis kha nas tshig 'byin pa'i tshul bya/ rgyal ba'i sku mtshan dpe'i dkyil 'khor rab tu mdzes par mtshon pa'i me tog kha dog sna tshogs 'thor bar mdzad pa'i me tog ma/ gur gum ltar ser po'am/ zla ba ltar dkar ba/ phyag mtshan me tog gi char dbab par mdzad pa/ puṣ+pe/ me tog ma/ phyag rgya gong me tog gi skabs dang 'dra/ bdug pa'i tshogs sna'i dbang pos snom pa tsam gyis lus sems la tshim pa'i bde ba ster bar byed pa'i cha nas bdug spos ma/ nam mkha' dang bcas pa'i dngos su rgyu ba'i du ba sngon po'i mdog can sbyar ba dang lhan skyes kyi spos snod thogs pa/ dhu pe ni bdug spos mas phyag rgya 'dra/ kun mkhyen pa'i ye shes shin tu gsal ba'i 'od dang ldan pa mtshon pa'i mar me ma/

glog gi 'od lta bu'i dmar ser gyi mdangs can/ 'bru mar sogs kyis bkang ba'i mar me'i sdong bu 'od kyis 'jig rten khyab pa bsnams pa/ ā lo ke/ mar me ma/ phyag rgya 'dra/ zag pa med pa'i bde ba zad mi shes pa'i shin tu sbyangs ba dang ldan par mtshon pa'i dri yi byug pa dang ldan pas dri chab ma/ pri yang ku ltar ljang gu'o// sin+dhu ra lta bu ljang ser gyi mdangs can phyag na dri'i chus gang ba'i dung chos thogs nas rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs ka'i thad du byug pa/ gan+dhe dri chab ma/ phyag rgya g.yon pa'i mtheb mdzub sbyar zhing lhag ma gsum brkyang ba kha gyen bstan/ g.yas pa de 'dra gyen bslang gis byug tshul bya/ 'di bzhi ka la rol mor bcas pa ni de dag dang rjes su 'brel ba'i gar dang bcas pa'i don rgya skad sor bzhag pa'o// rgyal ba thams cad dbyibs kha dog shin tu legs pa'i rang bzhin gyi gzugs can gyis mchod cing de yang rgyal ba'i ye shes kyi rang gzugs stong pa nyid kyi me long gi nang du 'phos pa'i tshul can gyi me long ma'am/ gzugs rdo rje ma/ chu shel ltar dkar ba/ shel sogs las grub pa'i me long phyag na bsnams par snod bcud sna tshogs pa'i gzugs brnyan shar ba snang la rang bzhin med pa/ rū pa badz+re gzugs rdo rje ma/ phyag rgya lag pa g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyi tshigs gsum steng nas g.yas pa'i thal mo kha phyir bstan gyen du bslang ba/ sgra ni pi waṃ sogs bzhir phyes pas tshang*/ dri ni dri chab ma yin pas ma bkod la/ ro mi zhim pa'i zas kyang ro brgya dang ldan pa'i zas su 'gyur ba 'dod yon lnga pa la sogs pa can gyi yon tan nye bar mtshon pa'i zhal zas ma/ dza ba ni/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen pos/ rgya skad dza ba zhes bya ba// me tog dmar po zhig la bshad// de yi brda' don mi shes par// byams pa'i mdza' bar 'chad par sogs// zhes pa ltar/ mdog dmar po can gyi me tog gi mdangs dang ldan pa/

ro brgya dang ldan pa'i zhal zas bsnams pa/ ra sa badz+re ro rdo rje ma/ phyag rgya rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phyes pa/ bag yod pa'i gos phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pas 'jig rten thams cad zil gyi non pa mtshon pa'i na bza' ma/ gzhung 'di nas margad mdog tu bshad cing*/ bde mchog las sna tshogs su gsung ba gang ltar yang 'gal ba med la/ srab 'jam shin tu yang ba'i lha yi gos phyag tu bsnams shing gzhan yang lus kyis reg pa dang 'khyud pa'i bde ba yang ster bar mdzad ma/ spar+ṣe badz+re ni reg bya rdo rje/ gos zung 'bul tshul dang 'khyud rgya dang mtshungs mdzad pa yang yod/ chos kyi dbyings gdod nas mi 'gyur ba rnam kun mchog ldan nyid du shes dang shes bya thams cad kyi sprul gzhi'am mtshon pa'i phyir chos dbyings rdo rje ma/ me tog ku mud kyi mdog dang mtshungs pa/ chos thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas rnam thar sgo gsum mtshon pa'i gzugs brnyan lag tu bsnams nas 'dod sred kyi zag pa'i cha phra mo tsam yang med pa'i bde ba ster ba mdzad ma/ dharmā dha tu badz+re ni chos dbyings rdo rje ma'am/ chos khams rdo rje ma/ phyag rgya ni rdo rje bsdams pa las mthe bong dang mdzub mo mthe'u chung rnams brkyangs te rtse sprad pa'am/ yang na mchod yon gyi phyag rgya la nor bu mig gsum pa'i phyag rgya zhes mtshan btags pa yang 'dug go /gsum pa ni/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dpral ba'i thad du bca' zhing*/ sngags brjod pas/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las rin po che sna bdun rim pa bzhin byung nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod par bsam ste/ sngags don ni/ oṃ ni sngar bzhin/ sarba bid/ rig pa thams cad/ pū ra pū ra/ mdzes pa mdzes pa/ sū ra sū ra/ gang ba gang ba/ awarta awarta ya ho/ kun tu 'phel ba kun tu 'phel ba nyid do// zhes pa ste rig pa'i stobs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod pa yid du 'ong zhing mdzes pa'i tshogs kyis sa dang nam mkha' bar snang thams cad gang zhing*/

gcig las kyang du mar 'phel ba'i don no// legs par gshegs pa dang mdzes par gshegs pa dang*/ phyir mi ldog par gshegs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal srid kyi thog mar 'byung zhing yon tan gyi khyad par du ma dang bcas pa'i dzam bu chu bo'i gser las grub pa'i 'khor lo rtsib stong dang ldan pa 'di phul bas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad mi 'khyud rgyud steng na yod pa'i rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi rtsib dang ldan zhing*/ sdug bsngal gsum gyi mu khyud kyis bar med du bskor ba'i srid pa'i 'khor lo tshe 'di nyid la rgyun bcad de/ bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas zung 'jug rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phangs brnyes pa'i sgo nas sems can thams cad kyi skal pa dang mtshams pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rnam pa thams cad pa bskor bar shog cig sngags don 'dra/ tsakra ni 'khor lo/ de bzhin du kha sbyor bdun ldan gyi rgyal dbang dang de'i sras sa la gnas pa'i 'phags chen dam pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la/ rin thang dang bral zhing*/ mtshan mo yang nyin mo ltar 'od byed pa/ gang 'dod pa'i mos pa ster ba nus pa'i nor bu rin po che 'di phul bas/ gnas skabs su zas gos sogs med pas bkren pa dang phongs pa/ mthar thug gi don chos kyi mthun rkyen ldog pa dang bral te bkren zhing phongs pa thams cad rgyun bcad de/ tshe 'dir log 'tsho dang bral ba'i 'byor ba dang*/ skye ba kun tu dam pa'i chos kyi 'byor ba phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par shog cig ma ṇi ni nor bu'o// gzugs mdzes shing lta na sdug pa/ ngo tsha khrel yod kyi rgyan dang ldan zhing chos bzhin spyod pa'i btsun mo rin po che 'di phul bas/ 'khor ba'i rtsa ba bdag tu 'dzin pa'i ma rig pa'i mun pa stug po yongs su bsal te rgyun bcad nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi nye bar bsten pa'i gnas zab mo stong pa nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa chos kyi dbyings 'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis grub pa'i don rtogs nas/

thabs snying rje chen po dang shes rab chen po zung du 'brel ba dang ldan par shog cig wasti ni/ btsun mo/ mkhas shing gsal la yid gzhungs shing rgyal srid kyi las thabs la mkhas pa/ bya ba thams cad la bzod pa dang ldan pa'i blon po rin po che 'di phul bas/ phyi nyan rang*/ nang byang sems/ gsang ba gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa ste gsum po theg pa'i yon tan gsum ldan zhing*/ bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i bstan pa chos kyi rgyal srid chen por rab tu 'dzin pa'i sgo nas/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad dang ldan par shog ma hasti blon po/ rgyal po la 'os pa'i glang po che gangs ri ltar dkar ba/ mche ba drug dang ldan zhing gser gyi drwa bas gdong g.yogs pa/ bya ba thams cad shes pa'i rin po che 'di phul bas/ 'jigs tshogs la lta ba la sogs pa'i lta ba ngan pa thams cad rab tu spangs te/ bla na med pa rdo rje theg pa'i theg pa zab cing brling ba la zhon nas/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i grong khyer nyam dga' ba der myur du 'gro bar shog hasti glang po/ rma bya'i mgrin pa'i mdog dang mtshungs shing*/ myur mgyogs kyi shugs dang ldan pas stong gsum chu tshod tsam du skor bar nus pa'i rta mchog rin po che 'di phul bas/ bdag cag rnams srid pa 'khor ba'i gzeb las myur du grol te/ thog pa med pa'i rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs thob pa la brten pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing rab 'byams su bgrod cing de dag tu bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la sogs pa dam pa'i chos kyi bka' yi bgrod pa chen po yang byed par shog cig tu raṃ ga mgyogs 'gro a shwa za byed yin kyang lo tsā bas don 'gyur du rta zhes bshad pa'o// phar g.yul du 'jug pa dang*/ tshur g.yul gyi bya ba btang ste ldog pa la mkhas shing*/ phas rgol thams cad 'joms par byed pa'i blo gros dang spobs pa tshad med pa'i dmag dpon rin po che 'di phul bas/

srid par 'phen par byed pa'i chags sdang sogs nyon mongs brgyad khri bzhi stong gi dgra las rnam par rgyal ba la brten nas/ bdud dang mu stegs kyi rigs su gtogs pa'i phas kyi rgol ba thams cad tshar bcad de/ bsnyegs pa ste 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phangs mchog ni thob par shog cig khaṅga ni ral gri yin kyang skabs 'dir don thob kyis dmag dpon la bshad pa'o// de dag gi phyag rgya ni/ lag pa gnyis rgyab sbyar sor mo rnams phan tshun 'khyud cing mthe bong gnyis lag mthil du bkug pa ni 'khor lo'o// khu tshur gnyis sbyar ba'i mdzub mo gnyis brkyangs te rtse sprad nas tshig cung zad bcag pa nor bu'o// rdo rje bsdam pa las gung mo brkyangs pa'i tshig dang por mdzub mo gnyis sbyar ba btsun mo'o// rdo rje bsdam pa las gung mo gnyis dang mtha' gnyis sbyar te brkyang ba blon po'i'o// lag g.yas glang po'i sna ltar brkyang ba'i gru mo g.yon pa'i thal mos brten pa glang po'i phyag rgya'o// khu tshur sbyar ba'i mthe bong so sor dbye gung mo dang srin lag gshib ste brkyang ba rta'i'o// lag g.yon snying khar phub 'dzin pa'i tshul dang g.yas ral gri 'debs tshul byed pa dmag dpon gyi'o// bzhi pa ni/ mchod pa bshams pa rnams dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams na yod pa'i gzugs sogs thams cad blos blangs te phul bar bsam zhing kha dog dbyibs legs sogs brjod pa ste/ de yang dkar ser dmar ljang sogs kha dog dang*/ zlum po dang gru bzhi sogs dbyibs legs shing bltas pa tsam gyis mgu bar 'gyur bas yid du 'ong ba mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan du byas shing*/ spel shin tu legs shing bar ma chad pa'i phreng ba dang ldan pa ste/ phyogs bcu dang dus gsum gyi gnas skabs kun mig shes kyis bzung byar gyur ba'i gzugs kyi mchog ci snyed mchis pa de thams cad bdag gi mos pa'i blos bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la 'bul na bzhes par mdzod cig

bzhes nas kyang bla na med pa'i dngos grub kyi mchog stsal du gsol/ sngags don rū pa gzugs/ kā ma gu ṇa/ 'dod pa'i yon tan nam 'di rnams la 'dod pa'i yon tan zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ 'di lnga po tshang ba 'dod khams kho na la yod cing khams gzhan na med pa khyad par gyi chos yin pas so badz+ra pū dzi te/ rdo rje mchod pa ste yul thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo la rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor bas rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du shes pa'i mchod pa 'bul ba'i don yin no// de bzhin du phyogs dang dus kun na zin pa ste skyes bu'i shes rgyud kyis bsdus pa dang*/ ma zin pa ste 'byung bzhi dang nam mkha' sogs las rang bzhin gyis 'byung ba'i sgra/ de yang rna bar snyan cing 'jebs la don bzang po dang ldan pa sogs kyi yon tan gyi tshig mchog dang ldan pa'i sgra snyan pa ci mchis pa rnams dang*/ tshig rkang tha ma gnyis 'dra la/ shāb+da ni rol mo/ yang phyogs dus kun na tsan+dan sbrul gyi snying po dang*/ a gar nag po sogs zhim pa'i dri dang ldan pa'i sgo nas sna yi dbang po la tshim pa'i bde ba ster bar byed pa rnams dang*/ gan+de dri/ phyogs dus kun na mngar ba dang skyur ba/ kha ba dang bska ba/ tsha ba dang lan tshwa ba/ de dag la nang gses kyi drug re dbye bas so drug de re re la yang lce shes la phan pa dang*/ 'ju bar phyogs pa'i tshe lus dang sems la mi gnod/ zhu tshe shin tu phan pa ste gsum gsum dbye bas brgya dang brgyad kyi ro dang bcud ldan pa'i sgo nas lus dang sems brtas pa ste rgyas par byed pa'i zhal zas kyi mchog ci mchis pa rnams dang*/ ra sa ni ro/ phyogs dang dus kun na 'jam zhing mnyen la 'khril bag chags pa'i reg bya'i khyad par lus sems tshim par byed pa rnams/ spar+ṣe zhes pa reg bya ste/ de dag gi phyag rgya ni/

thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba gzugs/ rol mo dkrol ba rol mo/ gong gi dri rdo rje ma/ ro rdo rje ma/ reg bya rdo rje ma gsum gyi phyag rgya bcas so// 'o na/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya bcas lan gsum re yong ba zlos pa'i skyon du mi 'gyur ram zhe na skyon med de/ nyer spyod kyi skabs de ni dngos su bsham pa nyid rgyur byas te 'bul ba yin la/ rig ma'i mchod pa'i skabs ni gzugs sogs lha mo'i ngo bor sprul te 'bul ba dang*/ 'dod don gyi skabs su de dag tu snang ba'i yul yul can rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor shes pas 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i tshul gyis 'bul bas khyad par shin tu che'o// smras pa/ nam mkha' gang ba'i de bzhin gshegs kun la// dngos bshams 'byor ba phra mo'i tshogs nyid kyang*// rnam dag sngags dang phyag rgyas byin rlabs te// ting 'dzin mthu yis phul ba cis mi mtshar// yid 'ong yid kyis sprul pa'i smin legs ma// rab mang rab mdzes gar dang glu'i bdag nyid// bsam yas bsam mi khyab pa'i yul mchod phyir// mngon bkod mngon rtogs 'di ni rig 'dzin lugs// lha yi lam las gser sbyang rtsibs stong pa// bab pas rgya mtshor bcas pa'i kun bzod ma// bdag gir byed pa'i rin chen rnam pa bdun// bla ma lha la phul de khyad par 'phags// dbang po lnga yi yul dang yul can kun// bde gshegs rdo rje gsum gyi rgyas btab pas// tha mal snang ba'i chom po ji snyed kyis// lan brgyar glag bral 'di ni thun mong min// mchod yul grangs med la phul n+ya gro dha'i// sa bon phra yang mchod 'bras kho lag rgyas// srid zhi'i khyon na mi shong de yis phyir// rna ba brgyad pa'i cho 'phrul rdzun du sgrub// ces so// gnyis pa nang gi mchod pa ni/ gang 'bul na rgyud sde nas 'byung ba'i sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga gtso phal dngos btags kyi rdzas rnams bsdu ba dang*/

sgrub pa tshad dang ldan par byas pa'i phab rgyun dang 'dres pa'i chags sogs la slar yang byin gyis rlabs pa nyid yin la gang la dbul na/ bla ma/ yi dam/ chos skyong*/ mkha' 'gro/ gzhung 'di nas bstan pa'i sde brgyad 'byung po 'gro ba lhar gyur pa dang bcas pa ste de thams cad kyang pho nya gsum la 'du'o// gang gis na mchog gi dngos grub don du gnyer ba'i rnal 'byor pas so// tshul ji ltar na/ dngos su nang mchod kyi bdud rtsi nas ro rnam par dag pa gos dkar mo'i ngo bo srin lag dang*/ gzugs rnam par dag pa spyan ma'i ngo bo mthe bong gnyis sbyar bas blangs te/ yid kyis mdun du bskyed pa'i thod pa las bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa re re spros te mchod yul rnams la phul bas bzhes par bsam pas so// skabs 'dir pho nya gsum gyi rnam bzhag cung zad bshad na/ spyir pho nya zhes pa ni rgyal po'i pho nya dang 'dra ste/ rgyal po'i pho nya de gang du btang na yang der btang ba'i las myur du sgrub pa bzhin/ dngos grub 'grub pa la shin tu myur ba'i don yin la/ de la sgras brjod rigs sam rigs kyi dbye bas gsum du 'gyur te/ lhan skyes dang*/ zhing skyes/ sngags skyes so// de dag kyang*/ slob dpon zla bas/ zhing sku dpag bsam shing ltar gsal 'gyur zhing*// yid bzhin nor bu ji bzhin rnam mi rtog /'gro sgrol bar du 'jig rten 'byor slad brtag /'di nyid spros dang bral la'ang snang bar 'gyur// ces gsungs pa ltar rgyal ba rnams thugs zhi ba bla na med pa'i go 'phangs zab cing rgya che ba'i ngo bo nyid kyi skur gdon mi za bar sangs rgyas kyang*/ dpag bsam gyi shing ltar rab tu gsal zhing*/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu bzhin du 'dod rgu 'byung yang rtog pa med pas/ 'gro ba rnams rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sar 'god pa'i bar/ 'jig rten rnams su ni dar/ su ni rgud/ su ni sdug bsngal dang bcas zhes brtag par mdzad pa'i sku 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing na kha sbyor bdun dang ldan par bzhugs pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku de la lhan skyes kyi pho nya zhes bya la/

yang 'og nas bstan pa'i gnas yul gyis dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma sprul pa'i sku sa bcu'am bcu gsum po so so la gnas pa'i tshul 'dzin pa rnams ni zhing skyes kyi pho nya dang*/ de lta bu'i yul so sor gnas pa'i ma rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs kyi rigs su skyes pa dang*/ rnal 'byor pas thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer spro bsdu sogs kyis byin gyis rlabs pa'i gang zag rnams ni las las skyes pa'am/ sngags las skyes pa yin no// 'o na skabs 'di'i mchod yul rnams ji ltar bsdu snyam na/ rtsa ba'i bla ma nas yi dam gyi bar ni lhan skyes dang*/ chos skyong nas dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor rdzogs pa'i bar ni zhing skyes de man chad sngags skyes su bsdu ba yin no// de ltar nges par byas nas skabs 'di'i tshig don cung zad 'chad pa la/ oṃ mchod do zhes mchod par 'bul bar dam bcas te/ de yang rang nyid gang las dbang thob pa'i rdo rje slob dpon de nyid/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa yin pa'i tshul rgyud sde thams cad nas gsungs shing tshad mar nges pa de'i don yid la nges pas de nyid bdag cag rnams kyi bla ma yi dam mngon du gyur pa'i yon tan gyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab cing khyad par ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa tshul bzhin mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ 'gro la bu ltar brtse ba'i thugs rje/ gang la gang 'dul gyi mdzad pa'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba/ bka' drin bla na med pa'i legs tshogs yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung gnas bla ma rin po che'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga dag pa ye shes kyi rang bzhin bdud rtsi de phul bas sku gsung thugs la zag med kyi bde bas mnyes te/ bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum la byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ de nas brgyud pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba/

rigs kun la khyab pa'i bdag nyid thog ma'i mgon po'am/ dang po'i sangs rgyas/ sangs rgyas kun pas sngar sangs rgyas pa'i chos sku mtshan ma dang spros pas mi phyed pa'i rdo rje 'chang de la skabs 'dir rdo rje chos zhes bya ste/ legs sbyar la badz+ra dha ra dang*/ badz+ra dharma gnyis ka ṭū dhṛ ka 'dzin pa'i byings las sgrub pas 'gal ba med pa'i khar don gcig tu 'gro bas so// de nyid gzugs kyi rnam par shar ba 'og min gyi zhing na bzhugs pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rdo rje chos dang*/ de nyid gdul bya'i snang ngo dang mthun par 'dzam gling sogs gnas so sor ston pa mchog gi sprul sku'i rnam par shar ba ston pa rdo rje chos de ni skabs 'di'i brgyud pa'i thog ma yin la/ la la zhig rdo rje 'chang chos sku/ rdo rje chos longs sku/ rdo rje sems dpa' sprul sku yin pa'i gti thug gi ngos 'dzin ni mi dgos so// de lta bu'i ston pa rdo rje sems dpa' de la thabs shes kyi cha gnyis las/ shes rab stong pa nyid zag med kyi bde ba bskyed pa'i yum mam/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad gang las 'byung ba'i gnas stong pa nyid de gzugs sku'i rnam par shar ba la rdo rje rnal 'byor zhes mtshan btags pa ste/ zung 'jug gi cha nas rdo rje 'chang dang rgyud gcig kyang drang don so sor snang bas brgyud pa so sor 'dren tshul tha dad pa zhig byung ba yin no// de lta bu'i rdo rje 'chang dpal he ru kaḥdang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas dngos su rjes su bzung ba la brten nas grub pa thob pa'i slob dpon dril bu pa dang*/ lhag pa'i lha 'di nyid kyi rjes su bzung bas tshe 'dir mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa ḍeṃ ki pa/ 'brang brdung zhabs dang*/ don dam rnam kun mchog ldan gyi ye shes mngon du gyur pa'i bar ma'i slob dpon nam an+dar ba zhes su grags pa ste 'di'i 'thad pa yang a mes kyis bde mchog chos 'byung las/

rje btsun sa skya pa'i lugs la rdo rje dril bu pa nas rnam rgyal gyi bar sogs mi dgos par/ dha ri ka pa nas bar ma'i slob dpon la ded pas chog kyang de dang an+dhar ba gcig gis/ rnam rgyal dang an+dhar ba gcig par mi bzhed pa'i phyir ro// zhes gsungs shing kun mkhyen gyis kyang de ltar gsungs mod/ yum gyi skabs 'dir rigs brgyud gang nas 'ded gsan yig dang yig cha snga mar ltos dgos la/ de ltar na nag dril gnyis dang brgyud pa 'di mi dgos pa yang gsungs pas dpyod ldan rnams dpyad 'tshal/ de yang skabs don la 'jug na/ rgyal rigs las rab tu byung zhing brtson 'grus mchog gis grub pa brnyes pa te lo pa dang*/ gnas lnga rigs pa'i paṇa chen dang grub brnyes yongs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba bram ze'i rigs las mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa nā ro pa/ mi yi mchog tu grags pa dang de nyid kyi slob ma rgya gar dang bod yul du gnam gyi rgyu skar ltar grangs mang yang*/ snyan brgyud slob bshad kyi brgyud 'dzin pa po bal bo pham mthing pa sku mched bzhi'i gnyis pa 'jigs med grags pa dang*/ de'i drung du lo bco brgyad tsam du mnyes pa gsum gyis mnyes par mdzad de dam pa'i chos tshul rgya mtshor dbang 'byor ba klog skya lo tsā ba shes rab brtsegs/ de gnyis ka'i slob ma skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags pa/ gangs can bstan pa'i mnga' bdag ris med 'gro ba'i mgon gcig zab rgyas rgyud sde'i dbang mdzod rje btsun sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ de nyid kyi nang thugs kyi sras thams cad kyi thu bo sku lus ma spangs par sku tshe 'dir dag pa mkha' spyod kyi grong du byon pa'i slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo dang*/ rdo rje dril bu nam mkhar bzhag cing nang gi zla nyi sgra gcan gyi rgyu ba la brten pas phyi rol gyi sgra gcan gyi rgyu ba bkag pa sogs grub pa'i rtags mtshan mthar phyin pa'i rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan rnam gnyis dang*/

phyi ma'i dngos slob mkhas pa'i yon tan gyis rig byed pa'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa'i ston pa 'phrog byed 'khor bcas mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs la sbyar zhing grub pa'i mthu dpag tu med pa la mnga' brnyes pas sangs rgyas byang sems du ma'i zhal 'bad med du gzigs shing gsung gi gnang ba thob cing shes bya ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i don kun mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas gnyis pa sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ srid dang zhi ba'i gtsug rgyan 'phags pa rin po che blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rnyed dang mi rnyed/ bde dang sdug bsngal/ grags pa dang mi grags pa/ bstod pa dang smad pa ste 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad mgo snyom zhing 'ching ba kun nas spang ba zhang dgon pa ba dkon mchog dpal/ rtse gcig tu sgrub pa kho na nyams len gyi mthil du mdzad cing mthar phyin pa'i slob dpon na bza' brag pa bsod nams dpal/ mdo sngags ma lus par mkhyen pa'i spyan ras yangs pa/ khams gsum 'gro ba'i bla ma chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun gong ma rnam lnga nas brgyud pa'i bshad sgrub kyi chu bo kun 'dus pa bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims dang*/ yang na bla ma dam pa nas mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug yar klung seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgyal mchog dang*/ yab rje grub pa'i dbang po 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan te/ 'di'i shwa lo ka chos rje gnas gsar bas gsar du bsnan pa yin kyang*/ tshigs bcad 'og ma dang gong 'og brjes na cung legs 'dra/ gong dpal ldan tshul khrims kyi 'phro nas/ mkhas pa'i dbang po shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rgyal ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis bde bar gshegs pa dngos dang mtshungs par mdo rgyud du ma nas lung bstan pa ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ 'khor lo sdom pa mi yi rnam rol mus pa chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ de yang yab rje gnyis ka'i dngos slob bdag chen rdo rje 'chang mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug blo gros rgyal mtshan/

gangs can grub mchog yongs kyi ded dpon rdo ring pa kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma/ snyan brgyud bstan pa'i srog shing tshar pa chen po blo gsal rgya mtsho/ nges par thams cad mkhyen pa gsar rnying gdams pa rgya mtsho'i bang mdzod/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug thugs kyi sras gcig mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug rta ra ba bsod nams chos 'phel/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ rje bka' 'gyur ba chen po 'a zhwa rdo rje 'dzin pa mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan 'di la rigs bdag po zhes brjod pa ni/ gangs can mgon po lnga pa chen po'i rigs bdag tu bzhes pa'i nye tshig yin no// snyan brgyud kyi mnga' bdag mkhan chen zhwa lu ba rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ yang dbang phyug rab brtan nas/ lnga rig grub pa'i dbang po ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor sangs rgyas rin chen/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po dang*/ yang dbang rab dang ngag chos gnyis ka las/ sngags 'chang thams cad mkhyen pa 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams dang*/ 'jam dpal rdo rje sngags 'chang bsod nams dbang phyug rigs kun gyi khyab bdag sngags 'chang thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' bkra shis/ de gsum ka las dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i rigs bdag rdo rje 'chang ngur smig 'chang ba'i gar gyi rnam rol/ bco brgyad pa lce btsun mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po kun dga' bkra shis/ mkhyen rab byams pa gsum gyi thugs las 'khrungs pa'i sras/ snyan brgyud bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ sa skya pa la yongs su grags pa'i lam 'bras che chung*/ gser chos bcu gsum las mgon po che chung sogs snyan brgyud gdams pa'i chu bo 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho/ gsang chen bstan pa yongs kyi mnga' bdag gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas/

'di man chad nas brgyud srol mi 'dra ba mang du gyes kyang 'dir nā len+d+ra'i brgyud rim ltar na/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros rtse gdong bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ bod 'brug pa ngag dbang blo gsal phun tshogs/ bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' mkhyen rab/ gzims 'og rdo rje 'chang dbyangs can mgrin par chags pa bstan 'dzin phrin las/ rig 'dzin chen po phyogs las rnam rgyal/ yongs 'dzin mtshungs med byams pa phrin las yon tan/ mkhas shing grub brnyes gzims 'og bstan 'dzin snyan grags/ de las rab dkar mtshams pa rin po che bstan 'dzin shes rab dang*/ yongs 'dzin ngag dbang klu sgrub/ rnam 'dren rdo rje 'chang chen po byams pa rin chen mkhyen brtse'i dbang po/ de las skyabs gcig gzims 'og rdo rje 'chang kun bzang bstan 'dzin gyis gsan pa'i bar du yod la/ yang de gsum ka las ngo bor lugs sor bzhag la ngor chen nas/ mus chen/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅge/ mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen 'jam dbyangs sa lo tsā ba kun dga' bsod nams/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po/ yab rje grags pa blo gros nas/ a mes kyi bar du brgyud pa dang*/ yang na sems dpa' chen po nas zhwa lu ba sangs rgyas dpal bzang mkhas grub dpal ldan rgyal po/ rje bzang po dpal/ mus chen nam mkha' dbang phyug sbas pa'i rnal 'byor chos kyi dbang phyug mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan nas a mes zhabs kyis gsan pa'i bar dang*/ yang na kun blo nas/ mus chen chos nyid ye shes/ lnga rigs kun dga' bkra shis/ pad+ma bdud 'dul dbang phyug theg chen bkra shis rin chen/ yab rje 'jigs med dbang rgyal/ 'khor lo'i mgon po 'phrin las rin chen gyi zhal mnga' las bdag gis thob pa dang*/ khrid kyi brgyud pa ltar na kun blo nas thar rtse nam mkha' 'chi med/

gnas gsar ba nam mkha' legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ 'chi med bstan pa'i nyi ma/ gsum ka las 'dren mchog ngag dbang rin chen/ bzhi ka las byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las rnal 'byor 'jam dpal bzang po/ de las snyigs dus bstan pa'i mnga' bdag ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta mkhyen brtse'i dbang po/ de las mi 'phrog pa'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rje'i mnga' bdag 'dren mchog ngag dbang legs pa'i bar du brgyud pa de bzhin rang rang gi gang las thob pa'i brgyud rim ltar shes dgos pa las/ mtshan snyan gang che dang*/ rang blo 'bab pa'i bla ma rnams 'di dag gi gral du bzhag na 'thus pa ma yin zhing gong gi dril bu pa dang ḍeṃ gi pa/ an+da ba rnams snga phyi'i go rim la zhib tu dpyad dgos par snang ngo*// nā len+d+ra'i cho gar rje gu ṇa bas skabs 'dir rtsa ba'i bla ma la nang mchod 'bul ba'i tshigs bcad gsar brtsom gnang 'dug kyang gong du song zin pas zlos skyon du 'gyur bas mi dgos so// gzhan yang smin par byed pa'i dbang dang grol byed kyi lam tshul bzhin du bstan pa'i rgyud kyi bshad dka'/ zab mo'i lam gyi man ngag snyan brgyud dang 'brel ba gnang ba'i dngos dang brgyud pa'i legs tshogs thams cad kyi 'byung gnas dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs rnams la/ ye shes lnga'i rnam par yongs su dag pa'i bdud rtsi dam tshig gi rdzas kyi mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul lo// de dag gi skabs su nang mchod spyi gtsug nas gtor/ de nas oṃ gsum ma'i sngags lan gcig gis mgo drangs pa ni bde mchog gi gzhung gzhan nas sngags mchod 'bul ba dang sgo bstun pa'am/ yang na slar yang mchod pa'i yul gsal btab cing*/ de tsam du ma zad gong du bshad pa ltar 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs thams cad kyi snying po yin pas de dag thams cad la mchod par bstan la/ mkha' dang mnyam zhing nam mkha'i khams rnams yongs su khyab pa'i chos kyi dbyings de bzhin nyid las nam yang ma g.yos kyang*/

zhing gi rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam pa sogs lha tshogs kyi sprul pas 'gro ba sems can kun gyi don mdzad kyang dngos grub 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pa bdag gi yi dam rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mar sngar bzhin mchod/ 'bul mchod gzhan yang gsang sngags te man+t+ra zhes pa'i sgra las drangs na/ ma na yid dang*/ ta ra skyobs pa ste yid mtshan rtog las skyob pa'i gsang sngags kyi de la yang*/ phyi lus ngag gi bya ba rtsal du bton pa bya ba'i rgyud/ lus ngag dang ting nge 'dzin gyi spyod pa cha mnyam du bstan pa spyod pa'i rgyud/ ting nge 'dzin gtso bor bstan pa rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par gong na med par bstan pa rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud de rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la 'bul ba'i mos pa dang bcas te snying ga nas gtor/ mtheb srin gyis lce rtse smin mtshams spyi gtsug rnams su thig le byas te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod pas phung po lnga rigs lnga/ khams dang skye mched rnams sems dpa' sems ma sogs kyi ngo bo gdod nas grub pa nyid thabs 'dis gsal btab ste lha la lha thim pa'i bde ba chen pos tshim par bsam/ 'dir la la zhig dpral mgrin snying ga gsum la gtugs par mdzad kyang 'di ltar mdzad pa nyid phyag len gyi khung gtsang zhing go rim de ltar 'byung ba yang bdud rtsi gtso bor gsung gi skabs yin pas gsung la gtso bor mchod pa yin pa'i phyir ro// bar phud kyang gtor mar phul bar bya ste/ de'i tshul ni nang mchod nas thur ma lta bus bcus pa 'das gtor nas bzung ste/ rim par 'bul ba nyid yin la/ ngag legs pas kye rdor sa chog tu nang mchod chu chang bcas kyis bran par bshad kyang skabs 'dir de ltar bran pa'i bshad pa sngar ma byung zhing shes byed kyang med do// de nas chos skyong la 'bul ba ni/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/

dpal nag po chen po la/ zhes bya ba yin la gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi dpal dang ldan pa'i mgon po lha thams cad kyi mchog rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po dang*/ lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma lcam dral dang*/ gnod sbyin yab yum dam can pu ṭa ming sring sogs bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas la phul bar bsam zhing snying ga'i 'og tsam nas gtor/ shrī dharmā pa la tsa tur mu khā ya/ dpal chos skyong zhal bzhi pa la bzhes pa ste/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug zhal bzhi pa/ yum chen sring mo bzhi zhing skyong pho mo 'bum sde pho nya dregs pa sde brgyad de/ dpal mgon bdun cu'i khar/ sman bla nas bshad pa'i gnod sbyin sde dpon rnams te sde brgyad sogs zhes kha'u pa'i zhal rgyun du yod ces grags pa ltar/ bka' la nyan pa'i 'khor tshogs thams cad la 'bul ba dang*/ shrī re ma ti ni dpal lha mo la/ bstan srung kun gyi gtso mo rdo rje rab brtan ma/ khol mo chu srin gdong can mang po dang las mkhan sogs zhing skyong gi ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa la 'bul ba ni/ gnas gsar ba'i gsung du med kyang dpal nā len+d+ra'i mkhyen rab chos rje gdan sar 'khod pa nas lha mo 'di brten cing chos ldan gyi phrin las sgrub pas rgyun tu gtor bsngo mdzad cing sgrub mchod kyi skabs 'dir yang dmigs bsal gyi phud mchod mdzad pa yin la/ oṃ gh+ri rā dza sogs ni dur bdag gi bsnyen sngags te 'di ni bod skad du bsgyur ba mi snang la/ 'dir mtshan sngags sbyar na legs pas de ltar na/ oṃ shrī ma sha ni pa tā dpal dur khrod bdag po la/ nub phyogs o rgyan gyi yul du zhing skyong gi dbang por mdzad cing gsang chen rgyud sde spyi dang khyad par ma rgyud kyi gnyer kha 'dzin pa/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug nor skyong dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum dang de'i bka' nyan pa'i sha za pho mo 'bum sde dang bcas pa la 'bul zhes pa ste 'di ni dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i thugs kyi sprul pa yin par rgyud nas dngos su bstan pa ltar skabs 'dir thun mong ma yin pa'i srung mar bzhed pa yin no// chos grwa chen po nā len+d+rar skabs 'dir chos rgyal sku lnga la 'bul ba'i tshigs bcad mdzad pa ltar na/

oṃ ma hā rā dzā ya/ rgyal po chen po la dpag par dka' ba'i mthu stobs bye ba'i bdag nyid/ mtshan dran pa tsam gyis 'dod dgu'i mchog thams cad sbyin par mdzad pa'i chos skyong rgyal po chen po sku lnga dang*/ de'i bka' nyan dregs pa'i rnam par brtan pa 'khor dang bcas pa la 'bul/ zhes pa ste 'di ni nges don du 'phags pa yin kyang*/ 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshul du bstan pa tsam yin pas nang mchod 'bul ba la skyon med pa ma zad/ 'jam mgon bla ma a mes chen pos phur pa'i rnam bshad du mtha' dpyod rgyas spros gsungs shing*/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' rin chen gyis pu ṭa dmar po yin par gsungs shing*/ kun mkhyen lnga pa chen pos kyang 'jig rten mchod bstod kyi dkyil 'khor du gnas pa'i dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu'i nang tshan du bzhed pa sogs gang ltar yang 'jig rten las 'das par grub bo// gzhan yang lung dang rtogs pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo gang du yod pa de skyong zhing*/ bstan pa srung ba dang*/ rnal 'byor sgrub pa po 'khor dang bcas pa tshul bzhin du skyong ba'i dam can mchog tu gyur pa sngon sangs rgyas mthong zhing dam pa'i chos thob pas bka' sdod chos skyong ba'i srung ma dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga 'khor dang bcas pa la 'bul zhes so// de nas yul nyer bzhir bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams la nang mchod 'bul ba la/ 'bul yul de dag gang du bzhugs pa'i gnas ngos 'dzin pa dang*/ de na bzhugs pa'i rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi ngo bo bshad pa/ ji ltar 'bul ba'i tshul tshigs su bcad pa'i don bshad pa dang gsum las/ dang po la yang phyi dang nang gi gnas gnyis su yod de/ dang po ni/ phyi rol gyi yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi po rnams steng tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas/ 'og gzhi rlung gi dkyil 'khor yan chad grub pa dang lhan cig tu yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi grub cing*/ bye brag 'dzam bu'i gling grub pa dang dus mnyam du/

der yang yul nyer bzhi grub pas/ de ltar na 'dir skabs su babs pa'i yul rnams 'dzam gling 'dir yod pa gtso bor bshad na/ de yang gnas kyi tha snyad du byas pa'i yul bzhi yod de/ pul+li ra ma la ya ste rgyal pa'i ri zhes bya ba/ dkyil 'khor kyi phyogs dang bstun na shar dang 'dzam bu gling du yod tshul gyi dbang du byas na/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad byon pa'i gnas yongs su grags pa rdo rje gdan lte bar byas pa'i lho phyogs na yod par bshad/ dzā lan dha ra ste/ ra ba 'dzin pa'am/ yang na dza la chu'i skad dod la a nī'i 'phel ba byas pas 'bar ba'i me la 'jug pas/ 'bar ba 'dzin pa ni rdo rje gdan gyi nub byang*/ rdo la me 'bar ba'i gnas su bzhed/ au ṭi na ya 'phur 'gro'i gnas ni dkyil 'khor dang mthun par nub phyogs su yod pa/ zur chags su o rgyan du grags pa de yin zhing*/ arbu dang mchod 'os zhes pa rgya gar lho nub kyi mtshams su yod pa de rnams yin no// nye ba'i gnas bzhi yod de/ go da wa rī ba'i mchog sbyin ma lho phyogs dpal gyi ri'i rtsa ba na/ chu bo go da wa rī 'bab pa'i 'gram dang ra me shwa ra dga' ba'i dbang phyug ma ste/ dga' byed dbang phyug gi byas pa'i dbang phyug ma'i rten yod pa'i gnas/ de wī ko ṭi lha mo'i mkhar rgya gar shar phyogs su yod pa kun mkhyen gyis gsungs la/ chos rje bdag nyid chen pos kyang de ltar bzhed/ lho phyogs na yod pa'i mā la wa phreng ba can te/ de brgyad ni mkha' la spyod pa'i 'jigs byed brgyad kyis bzung bas mkha' spyod kyi gnas su grags la/ ka ma ru pa 'dod pa'i gzugs chags pa shas che ba'i yul lho phyogs su yod pa dang*/ o ṭi bi sha/ phyi'i shar phyogs na yod pa dang gnyis ni zhing zhes su grags la tri sha ku ṇe/ dge ba gsum pa/ lho nub kyi char yod pa dang*/ ko sa la mdzod len te nub phyogs rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi yul te 'di la dge ba can du bsgyur ba yang yod pa 'di gnyis ni nye ba'i zhing yin zhing*/

ka liṅga ci mtshan nam smra ba'i rtags/ lho phyogs rgyal po'i khab/ la sba ka 'phyang ba can lho phyogs na yod par bshad pa gnyis ni/ tshan+do ha dang*/ kāñci ste bsgyur bag can lho phyogs 'di la grong khyer gyi mchog ces kyang grags mod/ chos rje rin po ches/ kāñci'i yul du phyin pa na/ pha bsad pa la rgyal rnga brdung zhes pa'i yul te/ g.yo sgyu shin tu che ba'i yul dang*/ zhi ma la ya/ kha ba can gyi ri ste byang phyogs kyi ri bo gangs can gnyis te sa bla na spyod pa'i 'jigs byed brgyad kyis bzung bas sa spyod kyi gnas dang*/ pre ta pu ri ni yi dwags kyi grong khyer zhes pa ste byang phyogs su yod la/ gṛha de wa khyim gyi lha lho phyogs su yod par bshad pa ste gnyis ni 'du ba dang*/ so so raṣ+ṭa ste yul 'khor bzang po rgya gar lho phyogs so ba nā tha zhes grags pa dang*/ su war+ṇa dwi pa/ gser gyi gling ste lho nub kyi phyogs su srin pos bzung ba'i gling chung gcig te de gnyis ni nye ba'i 'du ba'o// nā ga ra ni klu'i grong khyer lho phyogs nas rta na ga ra la sogs pa yul chen po bcu drug yod pa dang*/ sin dhu ni chu yi ming ste lho phyogs ngos chu bo sin+dhu 'bab pa'i 'gram du yod pa de gnyis ni dur khrod dang*/ ma tu ni mya ngan gyi thang lho phyogs na yod cing*/ ku lu tā rigs ldan te phyi'i lho nub tu yod par bshad pa ni nye ba'i dur khrod de/ brgyad po ni sa 'og na spyod pa'i 'jigs byed brgyad kyi bzung ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis sa 'og na spyod pa'i gnas su bzhag pa'o// 'di dag la ngos 'dzin tshul mi 'dra ba mang zhig yod kyang kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po bsod nams seṅge'i dgongs pa gtso bor bzung ba lags/ de dang 'brel ba gnas so gnyis dang gnas so bdun du kye rdo rje dang*/ dus 'khor sogs las bshad pa'i don rnams kyang 'dir mi bzhed pa ni ma yin kyang*/

dngos bstan gtso che ba nyid bshad pa yin no// gnyis pa nang gi gnas ni rgyud sde so sor mi 'dra ba du ma zhig yod kyang*/ bde mchog gi skabs 'dir/ spyi gtsug nas skra mtshams kyi bar phyed par byas pa'i dkyil pul+li ra ma la ya/ spyi gtsug tshangs pa'i bu ga ni dzā lan+dha ra/ rna ba g.yas pa'i bu ga'i nang o ṭi ya na/ ltag pa arbu ḍa/ rna ba g.yon pa go da wi rī/ smin ma'i dbus su rā me shwa ra/ mig gnyis de wī ko ṭi/ phrag pa gnyis mā la wa/ mchan khung gnyis kā ma dhu ba/ nu ma gnyis o tri bi sha/ lte ba rta'i sha ku ni/ sna rtse ko sa la/ lce yi rtsa ba ka liṅga*/ mgrin pa laṃ pa ka/ snying ga kañci/ 'doms bar te pho mo'i 'bras bu gnyis ni ma la ya/ mtshan ma'i rtsa ba pre ta pu ri/ bshang lam gṛ ha de wa/ brla rtsa gnyis so so rāṣ+ṭa/ byin pa gnyis gser gling*/ sor mo bcu drug na gar/ bso gong gnyis sin dhu/ rkang lag gi mthe bong bzhi ni ma tu/ pus mo gnyis ni ku la tā ste yul nyer bzhi khams drug ldan gyi gang zag gcig gi rdo rje'i lus skyon med pa la tshang ste/ ji skad du/ pu la sogs pa gang gsungs pa// phyi dang nang du yang dag gnas// zhes dang*/ ji ltar phyi rol de bzhin nang*// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// so gnyis dang po bdun sogs 'chad pa'i skabs su go rim dang*/ bkod tshul mi 'dra ba ni rgyud sde so so'i gdul bya'i snang tshul dang*/ grub brnyes kyi slob dpon so so'i bzhed pa mi 'dra ba'i khyad par bstan pa tsam yin no// gnyis pa der bzhugs pa'i rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi ngo bo ni/ gang du gnas kyi ming can bzhi'i rlung sems dbu mar zhugs pas sa dang po rab tu dga' ba'i rtogs pa skye zhing*/ sa de la rgyu'i sgo nas gnas zhes brjod pa yin/ de'i rten 'brel gyis/ phyi yi yul de na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor rnams kyang ngo bo sangs rgyas yin kyang rnam pa sa dang po thob pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa rnams dbang du 'du bar 'gyur ba'am/

yang na phyi'i yul der spyod pa byas pas dbang du 'dus te nang gi rlung sems dbu mar 'jug pa ni go rim ma nges la/ de bzhin du nye ba'i gnas ni sa gnyis pa dang*/ sbyar zhing de dag ni rgyal ba thams cad kyi thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa lha yi ngo bor shar bas dkyil 'khor 'khor lor yang thugs kyi 'khor lo la bkod pa yin no// zhing dang sa gsum pa/ nye ba'i zhing dang sa bzhi pa/ tshan+do ha dang sa lnga pa/ nye ba'i tshan+do ha dang sa drug pa sbyar te/ de dag gi ni rgyal ba'i gsung gi ngo bo yin la de'i rgyu mtshan gyis dkyil 'khor gyi skabs su yang gsung gi 'khor lo la bkod pa'o// 'du ba ni sa bdun pa dang*/ nye ba'i 'du ba sa brgyad pa/ dur khrod ni sa dgu pa/ nye ba'i dur khrod ni sa bcu pa dang sbyar ba ni/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi sku'i gsang ba bsam mi khyab pa'i ngo bo yin pas der gnas pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyang dkyil 'khor phyi mar bkod pa yin no// de dag 'di la zhib par bshad na/ 'og min gyi zhing na bzhugs pa'i longs sku'i 'khor lo/ 'dzam gling na bzhugs pa'i sprul sku'i 'khor lo/ phyi dkyil gyi lha'i 'khor lo/ nang lus kyi 'khor lo ste bzhi dbye ba dang*/ 'di dag gi skabs su mkho ba'i dgag sgrub kyi rig pa mang zhig yod kyang*/ cung zad tsam ni kun mkhyen chen po'i sdom gsum kha skong gi 'grel pa kho bos bgyis pa sdom gsum chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed du yod cing*/ da dung tshe yis srang na rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan bcos 'khrul bral rnams kyi dgongs 'grel 'ga' zhig bgyid par spro bas der 'chad 'gyur dam/ kho bo'i ngag las kyang longs shig gsum pa ji ltar 'bul tshul gyi don ni de ltar bshad pa'i phyi nang gi gnas dag las kyang skabs 'dir/ phyi yi gnas kyi ming can mchog bzhi dang*/ nye ba'i gnas kyi ming can mchog tu gyur pa bzhi po nam mkha' la spyod pa thugs kyi 'khor lo'i rang bzhin can gyi dpa' bo khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la dang*/

rnal 'byor ma rab tu gtum mo la sogs pa 'og min na bzhugs pa'i ston 'khor dbyer med kyi sangs rgyas de nyid 'gro ba 'dul ba'i phyir sa dang po dang gnyis pa la gnas pa'i rnam par bstan pa'i 'khor tshogs ma lus pa lnga/ zhes pa ste/ 'dir ni gtso bo sprul sku'i rnam pa can gyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma la 'bul ba yin la/ de nyid longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku las byung zhing*/ de yang chos sku'i dbyings las shar ba yin pas sku gsum ka la mchod par 'gyur ba'i tshul 'di shes dgos te/ don cung zad 'og tu smon lam gyi skabs su 'chad par 'gyur zhing*/ 'di ni rdo rje theg pa'i dgongs don bla na med pa 'jam dbyangs sa skya pa yab sras kyis ji ltar bzhed pa'i rnam bzhag smra ba'i seng ge mdo khams kyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen pos tshul bzhin du bshad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba nyid a pha'i kha phor gtsang zhen ma yin pa rgyud don man ngag gis 'chad pa'i gnad tshul bzhin du rig pa 'di ni bdag dal rten thob pa'i don shin tu che ba zhig go /da ni dkyus la 'jug par bya ste/ de bzhin du zhing mchog gnyis dang*/ nye ba'i zhing gnyis/ tshan+dau ha zung dang nye ba'i tshan+do ha gnyis te/ sa bla la spyod pa gsung gi 'khor lo'i rang bzhin la gnas pa'i dpa' bo aṅku ri dang*/ rnal 'byor ma e rā wa ti la sogs pa 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la 'bul ba dang*/ 'du ba'i sa gnyis dang nye ba'i 'du ba gnyis dang*/ dur khrod gnyis dang nye ba'i dur khrod gnyis na gnas pa/ sa 'og na legs par spyod pa sku'i 'khor lo'i ngo bo nyid kyi dpa' bo stobs po che dang rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo'i shugs can ma la sogs pa'i tshogs sprul pa'i sku'i rnam par bstan pa thams cad la 'bul/ zhes pa'i don yin la de nas gzhan yang 'thung gcod dang nye ba'i 'thung gcod zhes su grags pa sogs rgyud sde gzhan nas bstan pa'i ngo mtshar mkha' 'gro'i gnas rnams na bzhugs pa'i 'gro ba sems can gyi don tshul bzhin du mdzad pa'i dpa' bo dang*/

rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs rnams la yang 'bul lo// bshad ma thag pa'i yul nyer bzhi po'i khar phyogs mtshams kyi dur khrod brgyad bsnan pas yul sum cu so gnyis/ gnas nyer bzhi/ gzhan yang gdod nas grub pa'i dur khrod brgyad sogs na legs par bzhugs pa'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams la 'bul zhes pa ni slar yang mdor bsdus te 'bul ba'o// yang bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' nyan zhing skyong ba'i tshogs la 'bul te de yang*/ dbang ldan du nag po drag po dkar po ba glang khyu mchog la zhon pa rtse gsum dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ rgan byed ma rag mo/ 'jigs byed lha mo/ u ma bzhis bskor ba/ shar du drag po chen po glang chen la zhon pa ser po g.yas rdo rje 'dzin zhing g.yon gdan gnon pa/ rgyal ba ma/ rnam par rgyal ma/ mi thub ma/ gzhan gyis mi thub ma bzhis bskor ba/ mer lhas sbyin dbyu gu rtse gsum dang*/ ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin cing dmar po ra skyes zhon pa/ nag mo bzang mo/ nag sbom ma/ dbang mo bzhis bskor ba/ lhor nag po sngon po ma he la zhon pa/ dbyug pa dang mdung 'dzin pa/ zla ba mo/ drag tu sdang ma/ 'phyang ba mo/ 'phrog byed ma bzhis bskor ba/ srin po gtso byed sngo nag mi ro zhon pa/ ral gri dang phub chung bsnams pa/ mar me ma/ 'jib byed ma/ grong gnas ma/ rnal 'byor ma bzhis bskor ba/ nub tu 'jigs byed mi sdug pa dkar po zhags pa thogs pa chu srin la zhon pa/ drag mo'i gzugs can/ gzugs chen mo/ mche gtsegs ma/ thod can ma bzhis bskor ba/ rlung du dga' ba las 'das nag po/ ri dwags la zhon pa be con thogs pa/ thod phreng ma/ phreng can ma/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga sbrul chen ma bzhis bskor ba/ byang du log 'dren/ lcags kyu dang nor phyug 'dzin pa ser po/ gnod sbyin mi yi gzugs can zhon pa/ ral gri can ma/ dgra s+t+wa can ma/ rdo rje ma dang*/ gzhu can ma bzhis bskor ba/ gtso bo brgyad po phyag bzhis phyag tha ma gnyis spyi bor thal mo sbyar ba/

rang 'dra ba'i yum dang bcas pa ste/ 'khor phyag mtshan gyi ming byung na ral gri ma sogs ming dang mtshungs pa'i phyag mtshan bsnams pa ste bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad kyi grangs dang ldan pa ste de dag kyang nges pa'i don du he ru ka zhing skyong gi skur bstan pa yin pa ni gnad kyi gsal byed las/ de la 'di rnams kyi sku mdog phyag mtshan brgya sbyin la sogs pa dang 'dra ste/ brgya byin la sogs pa 'dul ba'am/ de rnams nyid btul ba'i rang bzhin zhing skyong ba yin gyi 'di rnams ni lo ka pa nyid kho nar blta bar mi bya'o// de bas na 'di rnams mchod pas skyon du ga la 'gyur/ yang 'di rnams 'jig rten pa'i tshul 'dzin pa nyid kyis ni/ lhag mas sbyin par bya ba'ang yin no// zhes pas bstan pa'o// yang gong du bshad pa ltar gyi gnas dang*/ rig dang sngags dang*/ las las skyes pa'i gnas gsum na spyod pa'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ nyi zer gyi rdul dang mnyam pa rnams la 'bul bar bsam/ de bzhin du gnod sbyin dang srin po dang 'byung po yi dwags/ sha za/ smyo brjed/ pho nya ste mkha' 'gro/ 'phrog ma ste lus kyi mdangs sogs 'phrog pa'i 'phrog ma ma bu lnga brgya dang*/ grub pa'i rig 'dzin te rdo rje theg pa'i nyams len la spyod pas tshe yi rig 'dzin sogs thun mong gi dngos grub thob pa rnams la 'bul ba dang*/ bod khams nye bar skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis zhes grags pa rten 'brel bcu gnyis gnas su dag pa'i ma mo de dag gi bka' nyan dang*/ bran g.yog gzhan yang gnas spyi dang*/ de'i nang gses yul dang*/ grong dang*/ gzhi yi bdag po gsar skyes glo bur ba'i rigs ma yin pa snga mo nas yod pa'i gnyug mar gnas pa/ thang rdor la sogs pa lta bu rdo rje theg pa'i dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul ba'o// bdud rtsi'i lhag ma ni dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro/ mi lha ma yin/

lha ste las kyis rnam par g.yo zhing 'gro ba rigs drug dang*/ lha ma yin stod smad gnyis lha dang dud 'gror bsdus pa'i lnga po ni lam rgyud lnga ste/ rgya cher rol pa las/ srid sred ma rig dbang gis skyes bo rnams// mi dang lha gnas ngan song rnam gsum po// 'gro ba lnga po dag tu mi mkhas 'khor// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// mngal sgong drod gsher rdzus skyes te skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyang zag med kyi bdud rtsi myang ba tsam gyis tshim zhing zag pa med pa'i bde ba mchog gi rgyud gang ste/ myur du bla na med pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig snyam pas thur du gtor de nas rang gi lcer bdud rtsi myangs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod pas snying ga'i bam̐ yig lha thams cad kyi ngo bor bsam mo// gong lce rtser reg pa dang 'di gnyis kyi khyad par yang*/ snga ma phung khams skye mched thams cad lhar gsal nas mchod pa dang*/ 'dir bshad ma thag pa'i don yin pa kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po bsod nams seng ge bzhed do// smras pa/ dam rdzas rnam dag bla med lnga phrag zung*// rang byung snod du bzhu skol bgyis pa yis// rmad byung zag pa med pa'i mchod pa de// 'bul bar byed pa rnal 'byor bla med lugs// mchod yul thams cad pho nya rnam gsum du// shes nas mchod pa'i ngo mtshar gsang ba'i gtam// rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rgyud las gzhan dag tu// ming tsam bstan pa med do dpyod ldan dag /smyo byed btung ba'i dngos po dpag med du// spyod nas rdzun tshig bshad la grub thob tu// rlom rnams me khyer lan brgyar ki ma ru// bsgom yang mi 'gyur dngos po'i gshis lugs bzhin// sbyang rtogs sbar ba'i dngul chu'i sbyor ba 'di// med na ma dag rdzas kyi lcags khams kun// bdag por yongs su dag pa'i gser gyi mdangs// mdzes rgyus min pa shes ldan yongs la grags// legs bshad gang dgar smra ba sngon bsags kyi// rgyud dang sbyang ba'i 'phangs 'gro zung 'jug la/

'byung gis ming skam rno bar cher bsnun la// lung rigs sgra snyan 'byung 'dod gad mo'i rgyu// ces pa yang bar skabs kyi gtam mo// gsum pa yid byung gi mchod pa ni gang ba'i phyag rgya zhes nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag la/ na mo chos kyi dbyings kyi sogs brjod pa ste/ de yang chos kyi dbyings rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ bde bar gshegs pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ sras byang chub sems dpa' dang bcas pa'i don du thugs bskyed pa'i thugs rje rang 'dod kyi 'khri pa med cing rnam par dag pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung gsang ba bla na med pa'i sngags dang*/ phyag rgya rgyud sde nas bshad pa ji lta ba bzhin bgyis pa'i mthu dang*/ rnal 'byor pa bdag gsang sngags kyi lam dang 'bras bu zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phangs la mos pa dang*/ de'i ched du zab gsal gnyis med kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa dang*/ sngon dang da lta'i bar du smon lam zab mo ji ltar btab pas dbang gis/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod pa'i bye brag rin po che sogs las grub pa'i ri dang*/ ro bcud nus pa dang ldan pa'i sman sna tshogs dang*/ yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chu dang*/ dpag bsam gyi shing dang*/ bde ba can sogs kyi bkod pa nas bstan pa'i rin po che'i shing la sogs pa'i shing*/ yid du 'ong ba'i mtsho dang rdzing bu me tog sna tshogs dang 'dab chags sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ yid du 'ong ba'i dri du ma 'phro ba'i spos kyi shing dang sbyar spos/ gzhan yang gter gyi bum pa/ ma rmos pa'i lo tog 'dod 'jo'i ba sogs yid du 'ong ba'i dngos po ji snyed yod pa rnams dang*/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar ba las byung ba'i mchod sprin te dkon mchog ta lar/

me tog phal cher me tog bla bre dang*// sogs gsungs pa ltar mchod pa'i dngos po de dag las grangs med pa la la ni bla bre la sogs pa'i rnam pa dang*/ la la ni 'od zer gyi rnam pa/ la la ni phyogs kun tu bkram pa'i rnam pa sogs rnam pa gcig tu ma nges par sprul pa ste 'di'i don khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po ches/ gang gi mchod rdzas zhing khams rgya mtsho rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin phung gis// rnam par brgyan pa'i rgyan gyi 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba'i 'od kyi rtse mo rgya mtsho yis// rdul gyi grangs snyed rin chen pad+mo rin chen 'od 'byin kun nas rgyas pa'i snying po la// lha dang mi yi 'dod yon dpal ster 'dod rgu'i dpal 'byung bye ba phrag brgya la gnas pa// zhes pas bstan pa'o// de lta bu byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bla na med pa'i rang bzhin so skyes dang theg dman gyi blos bsam gyi mi khyab pa de dag bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' re re'i spyan sngar yang cha tshang ba 'byung bar gyur cig ces brjod cing*/ bsam pa se gol gcig gtogs/ de yang smon lam gyi dbang gis yan chad kyis ni mchod pa'i rgyu bstan/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig ces pa yan gyis mchod pa'i ngo bo bstan/ de man chad kyis mchod yul bstan zhes kun mkhyen chen pos gsung bzhin don la yang gnas so// de nas sngags don sarba bid sogs gong du song*/ na maḥs man+ta bud dhā nāṃ/ kun nas sangs rgyas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// a bhi sma ra ye/ mngon par ngo mtshar ba/ s+pha ra ṇa 'phro ba/ i maṃ/ 'di/ ga ga na khaṃ/ nam mkha'/ dharmā dhā du/ chos kyi dbyings/ ā kā sha/ nam mkha'/ sa man+ta māṃ/ kun tu khyab pa/ sarba ta thā ga ta de bzhin gshegs pa/ par+ṇa maṇ+ḍa le/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor/ yang na a pa ri sho dha ye/ yongs su dag pa/

maṇ+ḍa le/ dkyil 'khor/ ma ma bdag pra ṇi dhi smon lam/ puṇ+ye bsod nams/ dz+nyā na ye shes/ ba le na stobs/ sarba ta thā ga ta de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad/ bar 'dir yi ge rnying par a dhiṣ+ṭha na yod pa ni byin rlabs/ pa len dha/ stobs/ ban dha swaḥs+thā na/ 'ching ba'i rang bzhin du gnas pa/ ba len+na stobs/ tsa kyang yi do/ swā hā gzhi tshugs shig de'i don yang chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'i ngo mtshar ba'i sprin 'phro ba'i mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor rnam par dag pa nam mkha'i khams gang ba la bdag gi mos pa dang*/ bsod nams dang*/ ye shes kyi stobs dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin rlabs kyi stobs kyis kyang 'bul bar bgyi'o// zhes pa ste/ kun mkhyen chen pos kyang 'byed pa gsung kyang*/ 'dir sdud pa'i sgrar bshad na 'thad par mngon no// sngags de'i skabs phyag rgya snying gar byas te sngags grub pa dang se gol gnyis btab pa phyag len la yod do// bzhi pa bstod pa'i mchod pa ni ḍā ma rus mgo drangs pa'i rol chen dang bcas te rkang pa brgyad pa'i sngags brjod de/ oṃ gong dang 'dra/ na mo phyag 'tshal lo// bha ga wa te/ bcom ldan 'das ma/ badz+ra wā rā hi/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ bam̐ sa bon nam zungs shig ces pa'i don/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyi don gong du song*/ de bzhin du ār+ya 'phags pa/ a pa rā dzi te/ gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ tre lo kya mā te/ 'jig rten gsum gyi yum chen mo/ ma hā bid+ye shwa re/ rig pa'i dbang phyug chen mo/ sarba bhu ta bha yā ba ni/ 'byung po thams cad 'jigs par byed ma/ ma hā badz+re/ rdo rje chen mo/ badz+ra ā sa ne/ rdo rje gdan nam/ a dzi te mi pham ma/ ā pa rā dzi te/ gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ wa sh+yaṃ ki ri dbang du byed ma/ ne tra bh+ra ma ṇi ye/ rgyan du bsgyur ba mo/ bi ṣa ṇi dug can ma/ sho ṣa ni/ skem ma/ ro ṣa ṇi 'jigs su rung ma/

kro dha ka rā li ni/ khro bar byed ma/ tra sa ni/ skrag mdzad ma/ mā ra ni gsod byed ma/ pra bhe dha ni/ rab tu byed ma/ a pa rā dza ye/ gzhan yis mi thub ma/ bi dza ye/ rnam par rgyal ma/ dzaṃ bha ni/ rmug byed ma/ staṃ bha ni/ rengs byed ma/ mo ha ni/ rmongs byed ma/ badz+ra wā ra hi/ rdo rje phag mo/ ma hā yo gi ni/ rnal 'byor ma chen mo/ kā me shwa rī kha ge/ 'dod pa'i dbang phyug ma/ zhes pa ste yon tan dang ldan pa'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs kyi bsngags pa yin mod/ 'di sogs 'khor lo bde mchog gi rin chen rnam bzhi'i sngags rnams/ sngags btu ba'i cho ga la brten nas dag par bya ba dang*/ spyi sbas mthar thug gi bshad pa byed par byung na shin tu legs kyang*/ deng gi dus 'dir sgra bshad tsam ma gtogs gzhan du bshad nus pa shin tu dkon par gda' bas bdag legs su 'dod pa rnams kyis brgyud ldan bla ma'i bka' dang brda' sprod pa'i gzhung rgyud sde'i dgongs pa gung bsgrigs pa'i bshad pa ci nus spro ba mdzad du gsol/ zhes thal mo sbyar ba lags so// gzhan yang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje sogs shwa lo ka gnyis kyis kyang bstod de/ de'i don/ gnyis su med pa'i dpal dang ldan pa'i 'gyur ba med pa'i rang bzhin rdo rje spros bral 'dus ma byas pa'i mkha' la 'gro ma/ nyi zer gyi rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba ste bdag po/ chos kyi dbyings la sogs pa'i ye shes lnga dang*/ bla na med pa'i sku gsum brnyes pas/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba thams cad skyob par mdzad pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang gi khyon kun tu ji snyed pa'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ kun tu rtogs pa'i 'ching ba gcod par byed cing*/ 'jig rten dang nye bar mthun pa'i bya ba rab tu 'jug ma/ de snyed rnams la yang phyag 'tshal lo// zhes te tshigs bcad dang po gtso bo dang*/

gnyis pa 'khor la bstod pa'o// de nas rgyas par spro na rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i bstod pa 'di bgyid de/ g.yas pas rdo rje phyag 'tshal ba'i stangs ka dang bcas te 'dzin/ g.yon pas tshigs bcad re'i mtshams su dril bu dkrol la tshig rjes don dran gdangs snyan po dang bcas te brjod par bya ba 'di'i don la sa bcad bzhi ste/ rigs bdag bla mar de dam bca' ba/ kha sbyor bdun gyi sgo nas bstod pa dngos/ sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub gsol ba gdab/ bstod pa'i dge ba mchod pa'i rgyur bsngo'o// dang po ni tshigs bcad gcig yin la de'i don la le tshan gnyis las phyed dang po'i don ni/ ji skad du/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi shes te// bla mas dus thabs bstan pa dang*// bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gzhan gyis bstan brjod bral ba'i lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes chen po'i mdzod 'dzin pa'i tshul gyi bdag sogs kyi rgyud la phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub 'bad med du ster bar mdzad pa'i chos kyi rje chos kyi rgyal po/ chos dam pa'i mnga' bdag srid zhi'i legs tshogs thams cad kyi dpal phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan zhing 'gro ba thams cad kyi bla na mngon par 'phags pa'i bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mo la yan lag mchog gis gus pas btud par byas nas/ phyed phyi ma'i don las su bya ba gang la 'jug na/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi yum gyur ste dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad shes rab kyi phar phyin la brten nas 'byung ba yin la lhag pa'i lha 'di nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ngo bo yin pas so// de lta bu'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la/ sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan la yid ches pa'i dang ba'i sems bcos ma ma yin pa'i sgo nas cung zad zhig bstod par bgyi'o zhes dam bca' ba'o// gnyis pa ni/ slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas/

longs spyod rdzogs dang kha sbyor bde chen rang bzhin med// snying rjes yongs gang rgyun mi 'chad pa 'gog pa med// yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas 'di nyid ni// bdag 'dod tshad mas yongs bsgoms blo can rnams kyang 'dod// ces sku gsum yan lag bdun gyi yon tan la bstod pa dang bdun las/ dang po longs spyod rdzogs pa'i yon tan la bstod pa ni/ 'dab brgya'i sogs te/ nyes skyon gyis rnam pa dag pa mtshon pa'i phyir 'dab ma brgya phrag dang ldan pa'i pad+ma'i lte bar yon tan yongs su rdzogs pa dang ma rig pa'i mun pa sel ba'i mtshon byed nyin mor byed pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis dang ldan zhing 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba'i spyan gsum steng phyogs su g.yo ba dang bcas te/ sku'i dkyil 'khor pad+ma rā ga ltar rab tu dmar zhing mtshan dang dpe byad kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba'i rje btsun ma 'og min stug po bkod pa'i mkha' la spyod pa'i rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku de la phyag 'tshal lo// gnyis pa kha sbyor gyi yon tan la bstod pa ni chags chen sogs te/ 'dod chags chen po'i dbang du gyur pa'i skyes bu dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa yongs su gdul bar bya ba'i phyir du/ brtan pa snod kyi 'jig rten dang g.yo ba bcud kyi sems can thams cad kyi bdag po ste de thams cad la khyab pa'i bdag nyid/ yi ge bzhi'i rang bzhin he ru ka dpal te bde ba chen po'i khrag la rol ba'i khrag 'thung 'khor lo bde mchog la sogs pa dang*/ gnyis su med pa'i lhan skyes bde ba chen po'i gar gyis rol bar mdzad ma/ bde stong dbyer med kyi mkha' la spyod pa'i kha sbyor chen po la dus rtag tu longs spyod pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// gsum pa bde ba chen po la bstod pa ni/ nyid thugs sogs te/ kha sbyor de yang sgyu ma'i skyes su dang*/

bud med sbyar ba dang 'dra bar bde ba gtan med dam/ yang na khyi phag dang 'jig rten rang ga ba'i 'khrug bde lta bu yin nam snyam na ma yin te/ nyid kyi thugs nyon mongs pa sogs kyi zag pa med pa'i bde ba chen po de yang skad cig tsam ma yin pa rnam pa kun tu 'gyur ba med pa'i dga' ba bcu drug la sogs pa'i yon tan gya nom bla na med pa/ dus rgyun mi chad pa'i bde ba mchog gi ros yongs su gang ma de ni 'gyur ba med pa'i mkha' la spyod pa'i bde ba che zhes yongs su grags pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// bzhi pa rang bzhin med pa la bstod pa ni/ rnam dag sogs te/ de lta bu'i bde ba chen po de yang rtag brtan ther zug tu grub pa zhig yin nam snyam na ma yin te/ gdod ma'i dus nas dri mas cung zad kyang gos ma myong ba rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings yod med rtag chad/ yin min 'gro 'ong gi spros pa thams cad dang bral ba 'dus ma byas kyi nam mkha'i dbyings ltar mtha' dbus skye 'gags dang bral ba yin mod de yang ci med cang med kyi ngo bo ri bong gi rwa lta bu ma yin pa/ mtha' yas pa'i zag med kyi yon tan mang pos nye bar mdzes pa'i/ rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang rab tu ldan ma yin pa'i phyir/ spros bral gyi mkha' la spyod cing dngos po dang mtshan ma'i rang bzhin dang bral zhing med pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// lnga pa snying rjes yongs gang la bstod pa ni/ gang gi sogs te/ 'o na de lta bu'i rang bzhin med pa de nyid chu zla dang*/ sgyu ma'i grong khyer lta bu'i stong kyang yin nam snyam pa'i log rtog bzlog pa'i phyir te/ rnal 'byor gang gi rang bzhin bshad ma thag pa bzhin spros dang bral zhing rnam par mi rtog kyang*/ thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can mtha' dag las re re tsam yang ma lus par rtog pa med kyang lhun gyis grub pa'i tshul gyis yid bzhin gyi nor bu ltar dgos shing 'dod pa'i don kun 'bad med du stsol bar mdzad ma yin pa'i phyir/

'gro ba kun gyi mkha' la nyin mtshan dus drug tu spyod pa snying rjes yongs su gang ba de la phyag 'tshal lo// drug pa rgyun mi chad pa'i yon tan la bstod pa ni/ srid dang sogs te/ de lta bu'i snying rjes gang ba'i mdzad pa yang sprul sku ltar dus re zhig pa yin nam snyam na ma yin te/ srid pa 'khor ba'i mtha' dang zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa'i mtha' dang bral ba yi mi gnas mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa zung 'jug mchog gi go 'phang de brnyes nas kyang*/ rgyun chad med par 'gro ba yongs kyi don mdzad ma yin pa'i phyir/ mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa'i mkha' la spyod pa ru rgyun chad med pa'i rang bzhin can khyed la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa 'di dag ni 'jug pa las/ shes bya'i bud shing skam po ma lus pa// bsregs pas zhi de rgyal rnams chos sku 'grub// sems 'gags pa de sku yi mngon sum mdzad// zhi sku dpag bsam shing ltar gsal gyur cing*// yid bzhin nor bu ji bzhin rnam mi rtog /'gro sgrol bar du 'jig rten 'byor slad brtags// 'di ni spros dang bral la'ang snang bar 'gyur// zhes pa'i don yang bstan pa'o// bdun pa 'gog pa med pa'i yon tan la bstod pa ni/ dmigs med sogs te/ dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen po'i gzhan gyi dbang du bsgyur ba la brten nas/ khams gsum gyi 'khor ba ji srid kyi bar du gnas pa de srid du/ mya ngan las mi 'da' zhing dus rtag par rab tu bzhugs par mdzad ma/ des na rtag khyab lhun grub chen po'i mkha' la rang dbang du spyod pas dus nam yang 'chi 'pho ba bstan pa'i tshul gyis 'gog pa med pa khyed la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa ste longs sku'i yon tan la gtso bor bstod pa'i dbang du byas pa'o// gzhan yang*/ yan lag dang po gsum longs sku'i mtshan nyid/ rang bzhin med pa chos sku'i mtshan nyid/ phyi ma gsum sprul sku'i mtshan nyid du yang bla ma gong ma dag bzhed pa yang mi 'thad pa ma yin no// de ltar na snying rje'i yongs gang du rgyun mi chad pa 'khor ba ma stong bar mdzad pa rgyun mi chad pa/

'gog pa med pa ni gnas par bzhed na 'khor ba ji srid du bzhugs par nus pa'i yon tan can du 'grel dgos te/ rgyan las/ gang gis srid pa ji srid bar// 'gro la phan pa sna tshogs dag /mnyam du mdzad pa'i sku de ni// thub pa'i sprul sku rgyun mi chad// ces gsungs dang mthun pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub gsol ba gdab pa la gsum las/ dang po sku yi byin rlabs zhu ba ni/ dbang bzhi'i sogs te de yang skabs 'di'i nyams len thams cad la dbang bzhi'i don tshang ba yin kyang*/ khyad par bskyed rim gyi skabs 'dir/ rang rgyud rnal 'byor rten dang brten par bcas pa bskyed pa bum dbang gi lam/ chos 'byung zla dkyil yig 'bru dang bcas pa gsang dbang gi lam/ zur bzhi'i dga' 'khyil shes rab ye shes kyi lam/ de la yang dga' ba'i dga' ba sogs bcu drug yod pa ni dga' 'khyil re re la 'khyil chung bzhi bzhi yod pas mtshon la/ dga' 'khyil zlum pos rnam rtog gi grwa zur med par mtshon/ de dag la brtag nas skyes pa'i zab gsal gnyis med kyi bde ba chen po ni bzhi ba'i lam ste/ dbang bzhi'i don dang ldan pa'i bskyed pa'i rim pa phag mo mkha' spyod du grags pa'i zab mo'i lam de thun bzhir bcad cing chags med du nyams su blangs te bsgom zhing yid ches dang 'dod kyi gus pa chen pos bstod cing gsol ba btab pas/ sku bzhi dbyer med pa'i bdag nyid zung 'jug rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sku yi rang bzhin/ 'gyur ba med pa'i mkha' la rnam par spyod pa'i sku yis bdag gi lus byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gnyis pa gsung gi byin rlabs zhu ba ni/ oṃ gsum sogs te/ de yang spyir gsang sngags thams cad las 'khor lo bde mchog gi skor zab cing*/ de las kyang rnal 'byor ma'i gsang sngags 'di nyid zab ste/ sgrub bya'i yul mkha' 'gro ma bsam gyi mi khyab pa rnams kyang bye ba phyed dang bzhir 'du/
